jobs.title: Strategic Data Acquisition Lead ( f/m/d) Data Hunter (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
At Siemens, we have bold ambitions to advance AI and become a truly data-driven enterprise. By scaling the Siemens Data Cloud and building strong data foundations, we enable the next generation of Industrial AI services.

We are looking for a Data Hunter to join and strengthen our team. This role is for someone who works effectively in complex and evolving environments, is highly self-motivated, and enjoys solving ambiguous challenges that may change over time. The ideal candidate combines strong customer-facing skills, including experience in customer discussions and contract negotiations, with a solid technical understanding of industrial data, AI service team needs, and the way Siemens operates in this space. This is an entrepreneurial, structure-building role for someone who is energized by unclear situations, enjoys shaping topics that have not been done before, and is comfortable experimenting, learning, and collaborating within a few essential guardrails. The clear focus is on the outcome: securing as much relevant, high-value data as possible. Your Role in Our Vision You will play a key role in identifying and securing the data assets required to advance Siemens’ strategic AI initiatives. Working closely with AI teams, Sales, Supply Chain Management, Legal, and IT, you will unlock high-value data across customers, suppliers, partners, and internal ecosystems. You will bring clarity to complex, federated environments by translating AI/ML and business data needs into actionable data acquisition strategies across systems such as PLM, IoT/OT, ERP, and MES. Through proactive engagement and negotiation, you will create opportunities for data sharing and ensure timely access to trusted, compliant, and high-impact datasets that enable digital products and enterprise-wide AI capabilities. You will ensure that each data acquisition is compliant, contractually sound, and scalable, bridging product needs, partner realities, and Siemens governance requirements. What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Appealing Siemens pension benefits- Access to Siemens share plans- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locations

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You’ll make an impact by:

- Identify, assess, and qualify high-value data sources both within Siemens and across the external ecosystem, ensuring alignment with product and business needs. - Translate data needs into clear technical and commercial requirements, including specifications, acceptance criteria, metadata, lineage, governance controls, and measurable quality standards. - Develop data-sourcing strategies and acquisition roadmaps, prioritizing opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and time to access. - Build a strong pipeline of prospective data partners, lead strategic discussions, and coordinate outreach together with Sales and Supply Chain Management—with the goal of establishing successful data partnership agreements. - Collaborate with Siemens teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners to identify partnership opportunities, negotiate suitable collaboration models, and prepare contractual agreements. - Enable product-driven data evaluation by establishing effective feedback loops with data partners and proactively addressing data availability and quality gaps. - Expand the Siemens Data Alliance by attracting, onboarding, and developing new data-sharing partners. - Identify and manage legal, regulatory, and commercial risks related to export control, intellectual property, data privacy, personally identifiable information, and licensing. - Work closely with Legal, Cybersecurity, IT, and Data Engineering to establish secure and compliant solutions for data transfer, storage, lifecycle management, retention, and end-of-life handling.

Your defining qualities:- Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline. - Experience & Skills:- At least eight years of relevant professional experience in data acquisition, data consulting, data architecture, data governance, or a comparable strategic data role—preferably within an industrial, manufacturing, or engineering environment. - A strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including data management systems, data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud-based data architectures such as Snowflake, AWS, and Microsoft Azure. - Proven experience in developing external partnerships, leading commercial discussions, and negotiating contractual agreements related to data acquisition or data sharing. - Sound knowledge of data governance frameworks as well as data quality, metadata management, and data lineage principles. - A strong understanding of data security, privacy regulations, intellectual property protection, licensing, and export-control requirements. - Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, combined with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships with internal and external partners. - The ability to translate complex technical and regulatory topics into clear business implications and actionable decisions.

- Ways of working:- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, paired with a proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset. - A high level of curiosity and the motivation to continuously learn, challenge existing approaches, and adapt to an evolving data landscape.
- Languages: Fluency in English; additional language skills are an advantage.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.title: Cloud Developer (w/m/d) / Remote Spain (Cloud-Architect)
jobs.description:
Willkommen in der Welt der medizinischen Innovationen!

Bei Mesalvo geht es nicht nur um Technologie – es geht um Menschen, um Fortschritt und um die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle. Wir sind ein Unternehmen, das von der Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und modernste Technologien angetrieben wird. Unsere Grundlage ist eine tiefe medizinische Expertise, auf der wir innovative und vernetzte Softwarelösungen aufbauen. Unsere Vision ist klar: ein maßgeschneidertes, digitales Gesundheitsmanagement, das den Klinikalltag erleichtert.

Unsere Geschichte begann 2021, als wir fünf renommierte Unternehmen der Health Care IT-Branche unter einem Dach vereinten. Diese Fusion brachte nicht nur verschiedene Expertisen und Werte, sondern auch 460+ hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende an insgesamt 7 Standorten in Deutschland, Belgien und Spanien zusammen.

Klingt das nach einem Umfeld, in dem du dich entfalten möchtest? Dann werde Teil der Mesalvo-Familie und trage dazu bei, dass die Gesundheitsversorgung smarter, effizienter und menschenorientierter wird. Deine Ideen, deine Leidenschaft und dein Engagement sind hier gefragt – denn gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied! Empower Excellence in Health and Care: #empowerexcellence

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich

- Du wirst Teil unseres Softwareentwicklungsteams und arbeitest an unserer innovativen Logistiklösung für Krankenhausapotheken namens Ataxe Web
- Du gestaltest, entwickelst und optimierst moderne cloudnative Anwendungen auf Basis von Java 21 und Spring Boot
- Du konzipierst und implementierst zukunftsfähige Microservice-Architekturen
- Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme höchsten Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Datenschutz und Kosteneffizienz gerecht werden
- Du entwickelst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in bestehende Anwendungen
- Du arbeitest mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL und MongoDB, inklusive Performance-Optimierung und Sicherstellung der Datenkonsistenz
- Du setzt auf moderne Entwicklungspraktiken wie Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean Code
- Du arbeitest eng mit Frontend-Entwickler:innen sowie interdisziplinären Teams zusammen

Das bringst Du mit

- Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java 21
- Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse im Spring Framework, Spring Boot und Hibernate mit
- Du hast Erfahrung mit Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean-Code-Prinzipien
- Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Cloud-Services sammeln
- Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken, insbesondere in den Bereichen Redundanzvermeidung, Performance-Optimierung und Datenkonsistenz
- Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung verteilter Systeme mit Fokus auf moderne Cloud-Anforderungen
- Du gehst sicher mit Docker um
- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Unser Angebot als Arbeitgeber

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten: In Absprache mit deinem Team kannst du entscheiden, wann dein Tag startet.
- Remote Work: Mobiles Arbeiten, Home-Office oder bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland - du entscheidest wo du dich am wohlsten fühlst.
- Mitarbeitenden Benefits: Vom Jobrad bis zum Fitnessstudio – deine Bewegung kommt bei uns nicht zu kurz.
- Gesundheitsförderung: Freu dich auf verschiedene Angebote, die deiner Gesundheit guttun – denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.
- Events: Damit der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt, organisieren wir regelmäßig Firmenläufe, Teamevents und Weihnachtsfeiern.
- Onboarding: Sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch ein nettes und offenes Team – dieses steht dir während deines Onboarding-Prozesses jederzeit zur Verfügung.

Unser Herz schlägt für IT und wir leben Diversity

Wir haben die Charta der Vielfalt unterzeichnet und setzen uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion am Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir freuen uns über eine Vielfalt an unterschiedlichen Bewerbenden, die mit uns noch erfolgreicher werden möchten und Ihre Leidenschaft mit uns teilen.

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Refactoring, Programmiersprache Java, Test-driven Development (TDD)
Expertenkenntnisse: Spring Framework, Hibernate Framework, Cloud Computing

Wir freuen uns, Sie kennenzulernen und nehmen gerne Ihre online\-Bewerbung entgegen. Für Auskünfte stehen Ihnen Frau Renate Mori, Tel. , oder Herr Silvio Evangelisti, Tel. , gerne zur Verfügung.

Das Amt für Justizvollzug (AJV) ist mit rund 1000 Mitarbeitenden innerhalb der Sicherheitsdirektion des Kantons Bern (SID) für den offenen und geschlossenen Straf\- und Massnahmenvollzug an Erwachsenen und Jugendlichen verantwortlich. Governance, Risk \& Compliance Manager  
Die RUAG Real Estate AG ist Immobilienkompetenzzentrum und Tochtergesellschaft der RUAG MRO Holding AG. Wir planen und realisieren massgeschneiderte Raum\-, Bau\- und Dienstleistungslösungen innerhalb unseres eigenen Immobilienportfolios an zentralen Standorten der Schweiz. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Dualität von Anlage\- und Betriebsimmobilien, insbesondere für Spezialobjekte in den Bereichen Aviatik, Rüstungstechnologien und hochsichere Infrastrukturen. Darüber hinaus schaffen unsere Raumlösungen und Betreiberleistungen optimale Bedingungen für den Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden. Mit einem ganzheitlichen Ansatz entlang des gesamten Immobilien\-Lebenszyklus, digitalen Lösungen und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen stehen wir für höchste Professionalität und nachhaltige Wertschöpfung.  
Governance, Risk \& Compliance Manager  
100  
Bern  
Das kannst du bewegen  
Zentrale Anlaufstelle für alle GRC\-Themen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Konzern, RUAG Real Estate und externen Providern  
Verantwortlich für die Fachrollen Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Trade\-Compliance, Business Continuity Management (BCM) und Risk  
Verantwortlich für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des Informationssicherheits\-Managementsystems (ISMS) sowie die Einhaltung des Grundschutzes und Überwachung interner und externer Provider hinsichtlich vertraglicher SLAs und Compliance\-Vorgaben  
Koordination von GRC\-Initiativen als Projektleiter in Abstimmung mit dem Konzern zur Einhaltung und Sicherstellung der Konzernvorgaben und Überwachung regulatorischer Entwicklungen sowie Verantwortung für die Prüfung und Ausarbeitung lokaler Weisungen und Unterstützung beim Betrieb eines Dokumentationssystems  
Steuerung des gesamten Risikoprozesses, einschliesslich der proaktiven Identifizierung und Bewertung von Geschäfts\- sowie IT\-Risiken, der Durchführung von regelmässigen Risiko\-Reviews und Pflege des Risikosystems der RUAG Real Estate  
Erstellen von adressatengerechte Statusberichten und Dashboards für die Bereichsleitung sowie Durchführung von regelmässigen Sensibilisierungskampagnen für die Mitarbeitenden  
Vorbereitung von internen sowie externen Audits und Unterstützung bei deren Durchführung sowie Gewährleistung einer lückenlosen Dokumentation für Compliance\-Nachweise  
Das bringst du mit  
Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung  
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Dokumentation von Prozessen oder Kontrollen sowie in der Mitarbeit oder Leitung von Projekten, idealerweise ein einem regulatorischen Umfeld  
Fundiertes Verständnis für IT\-Sicherheit und Datenschutz, vorzugsweise mit Kenntnissen des revidierten Datenschutzgesetzes (revDSG)  
Erfahrung im Risikomanagement sowie in der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Richtlinien und Frameworks nach ISO 27001 oder NIST  
Gutes Verständnis für die Funktionsweise von Service Level Agreements (SLAs)  
Kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit hoher Verbindlichkeit und souveränem Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Stakeholdern  
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe für komplexe Konzernvorgaben sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und exakte Arbeitsweise  
Hohe digitale Kompetenz sowie Affinität zu digitalen Tools, GRC\-Softwarelösungen und der MS\-Office\-Palette insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint  
Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift  
Erfüllst du nicht alle Voraussetzungen hundertprozentig? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir sind stets auf der Suche nach talentierten und motivierten Personen, die unser Team bereichern möchten. Wir legen grossen Wert auf Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit und unser Ziel ist es, ein vielfältiges Team aufzubauen, in dem alle ihre persönlichen Stärken voll entfalten können. Wir ermutigen insbesondere alle Personen, unabhängig von ihrem Geschlecht, die möglicherweise Bedenken haben, eine Stelle in einem armeenahen Umfeld anzunehmen, sich zu bewerben.  
Über den Bereich  
Die Funktion GRC verantwortet die strategische und operative Steuerung der Themen Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Risikomanagement und Business Continuity Management (BCM). Sie stellt die Konformität zu Konzernvorgaben sicher, treibt zentrale Sicherheitsprojekte voran und optimiert die Service\-Level\-Agreements (SLAs) für RUAG und RRE, um einen stabilen und geschützten Geschäftsbetrieb zu garantieren.  
Deine Vorteile

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organization. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, scalability and public value. jobs.title: Head of Geospatial AI - Foundation Models and Geo-Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland,  in areas such as natural hazards, agriculture, and forestry.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Head of Geospatial AI, you will spearhead the Geo-Intelligence Team and own the development and implementation of ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI, data and shared platform capabilities. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define and implement ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI and technical strategy
Based on broad inputs, establish the target architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic systems, geospatial data pipelines, compute environments and the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform
Adopt or set technical standards, priorities, interfaces and development principles aligned with GeoLab strategy and mission requirements
Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national competence centre for Earth observation
A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: IBU Access & Value Lead - Orexin Franchise
jobs.description:
About the Role:
- Brands in-scope: Oveporexton
- Be an active member of the Takeda’s access community and value chain that ensure patients have access to innovative treatments ensuring timely, sustainable reimbursement and uptake through robust payer value propositions, evidence generation, HTA readiness, and effective cross-functional delivery.
- Work very closely with Global Access Strategy team to ensure execution within IBU.
- Lead and own IBU access strategy, provide strategic inputs for 6 core markets, and execute market access readiness across international markets for Oveporexton. Ensure integrating disease‑area insights, payer expectations, competitive intelligence, and evidence‑generation requirements to inform IBU decisions and maximize patient access in international markets.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Be part of Global Pricing and Access (GPA) function, contributing to advance GPA governance and ways of working, to influencing functional excellence (Access, Pricing, cross‑TA collaboration, capability building) and to shaping the access vision and capability roadmap.

How you will contribute:
IBU - Oveporexton Access Business Partner
- Plan and execute initiatives across IBU markets to ensure the global access and pricing strategy’s success of Oveporexton in a competitive, highly regulated environment.
- Serve as primary point of contact for IBU Local Access teams for Oveporexton; drive access and pricing strategy execution to enable timely patient access, including P&R success through strong HTA readiness and payer negotiation preparedness, as well as sustained value maximization across life cycle management.
- Partner with LOCs to set the right ambition for LOCs and guide the LOCs with the scenario planning and access plan development to maximize access opportunities. Provide hands-on guidance for priority markets and high-stakes negotiations.
- Support LOCs directly for their value proposition development, negotiation preparation, competitive response, and complex payer interactions.
- Support contracting / access levers where relevant (e.g., VBC, Entry agreements, business cases development, patient support approaches), aligned to compliance requirements and corporate governance.
- Ensure reporting and transparency of access strategy execution and pricing actions, reimbursement status, payer risks, and readiness KPIs for senior leadership.
- Develop an updated IBU access strategy by systematically integrating key insights from leading international congresses and external payer forums within the relevant therapeutic area.
- Proactively foster a growth mindset across and beyond P&R/HTA requirements by encouraging Takeda’s access community to engage with the broader external healthcare ecosystem, including patient voice and services, medical partners to leverage further real-world evidence (RWE) and data generation initiatives, publication planning, to adopt digitalization opportunities, and to systematically apprehend evolving legislative developments.
- Manage and coordinate budget for assigned assets.

GPA / Global Collaboration
- Work closely with Global Pricing & Access Strategy teams to support Pricing & Access optimization by developing analysis, contributing to pricing research, and ensuring P&R guidance is implemented consistently across the IBU.
- Anticipate LOE, biosimilar/generic impact, expansion of indication, external pressure, and competitive responses unique to the TA working closely with the LOE offices.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Connect local, IBU, and global teams to strengthen the value proposition through fit‑for‑purpose deliverables (e.g., value dossiers, health economic evidence, objection handler, negotiation playbook, training) that improve value perception and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across markets.
- Collaborate with medical and evidence generation / HEOR teams to identify evidence gaps and integrate timely access needs within the evidence strategy, ensuring new clinical data and RWE strengthens payer value narratives (contributing to business cases to support prioritization of evidence generation as needed).

Future Readiness / capability
- Monitor and interpret market access trends, reimbursement policy changes, and coverage decisions; identify payer evidence gaps; and translate insights into actions on emerging opportunities and risks, in partnership with GPA access strategy and pipeline teams.
- Lead a multi‑layer TA Access function across the IBU to ensure cross‑market consistency, execution excellence, share practices and accelerated access outcomes; define TA‑specific capabilities and implement the agreed operating model in partnership with Global Access, Global Pricing, IBU Medical, MCE, and IBU Regulatory.
- Equip, guide and train local teams/partners with processes, standards, tools, and decision frameworks to build high-quality LOCs access excellence in execution.
-Lead and be a role model to digital capability adoption throughout the access community
- Develop and run mock negotiations within the specific TA and orchestrate capability training, and simulation exercises for markets.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across GPA teams, access and cross-functions and geographies partners.
- Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives sponsored by the GPA function or Takeda, broadening organizational impact, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and driving enterprise value (mAI access – CXF – JHTA – VBHC ...)

Skills:
- Solid experience in Local and preferably Regional Market Access & Pricing, with demonstrated leadership across TA areas and complex payer environments.
- Proven ability to shape TA‑level access strategy across the full asset lifecycle (launch, inline, LOE), including advisory to senior governance bodies.
- Deep knowledge of global payer systems, reimbursement pathways and pricing dynamics, particularly across Europe and Intercontinental markets.
- Strong portfolio readiness expertise, including payer scenario planning, pricing insights & trends, evidence requirements, and competitive access risk management.
- Advanced capability to integrate clinical, HEOR, RWE and competitive insights into clear payer value propositions and access decision‑making.
- Demonstrated matrix leadership, working effectively with Global Access, Pricing, Medical, Regulatory and Commercial partners and being at ease to navigate a complex matrix of multi stakeholders.
- Project/program management and prioritization capability across parallel workstreams and deadlines.
- People and capability cross-functional influencing experience, including leading multi‑layer, geographically dispersed Access teams and driving functional capability development.
- Learning agility to adapt to new assets within the assigned TA, portfolio or any new situation, continuing to lead within changes and uncertainties and deliver results.
- Strategic thinking: Ability to think strategically and make sound, forward-looking decisions, based on strong business acumen to identify challenges and opportunities and drive impact.
- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.
- Resilience with ambiguity and cross-cultural collaboration across international markets/partners.
- Digital and AI-forward: Experience leveraging digital platforms, data analytics, and AI-driven tools to enhance decision-making and access strategy execution is a plus

Softwareentwickler HMI (m/w/d)

Hier entwickeln und produzieren wir mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitenden innovative, kundenspezifische Verpackungs\- und Handling\-Systeme für anspruchsvolle Hochleistungsanwendungen.

In dieser spannenden Position bist du verantwortlich für die Realisierung unserer HMI\-Applikationen für Kundenprojekte und unterstützt die Inbetriebnahme \- Vom Angebot bis zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss beim Kunden.

Die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer maschinenspezifischen Applikationsvorlagen ist ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit, um eine hohe Qualität unserer Visualisierungs\-Applikationen zu gewährleisten.  
Du unterstützt unseren Verkauf bei der Angebotserstellung durch Bewertung von Kundenspezifikationen.

Mit deiner aktiven Mitarbeit bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Arbeitsprozesse leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag, um Projekte termingerecht und in hoher Qualität abwickeln zu können.  
Interner Wissenstransfer sowie die Erstellung von Dokumentation runden das Tätigkeitsprofil ab.  
Qualifikationen

Umfangreiche Erfahrungen in der Programmierung von HMI / SCADA \- Systemen, z.B. Rockwell Factory\-Talk, Copa\-Data Zenon oder WinCC.  
Du bringst ein Flair für Usability und User Experience Themen mit.  
Mit Steuerungssystemen wie z.B. von Rockwell, oder Beckhoff und den gängigen Schnittstellen zu HMI\-Systemen bist du vertraut.  
Du bist sehr gut vertraut mit Programmiersprachen wie C\#, .NET, zusätzliche Erfahrungen mit Webprogrammierung und/oder sind von Vorteil.  
Kenntnisse im Bereich Konfiguration und Administration von Windows und/oder Linux Betriebssystemen, sowie in der Netzwerktechnik und der IT Security.

Praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Industrie\- und Webprotokolle wie REST, OPC\-UA und MQTT sind hilfreich.  
Du hast Flair für den Automatisierungslösungen und Sondermaschinenbau und arbeitest gerne im Team, bist aber auch gewohnt, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert vorzugehen.  
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und professionelles Auftreten sind wichtig für die internationalen Kundenkontakte und gelegentlichen Reisen zu Kunden

Start: Sofort oder nach Vereinbarung  
Pensum: 100%  
Unbefristete Anstellung  
Arbeitsort: Beringen  
Bei dieser Stelle arbeiten wir nicht mit Personalvermittlern zusammen!  
Benefits:

UniBE is central.

fixed\-term  
Institution / Workplace

About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering, testing, and scientific support of one of Europe's premier planetary science missions.  
Key Responsibilities  
The successful candidate will play a central role in supporting the development, testing, and operation of NIM, including:  
Planning and conducting calibrations and tests of the instrument under various operational conditionsLeading the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of hardware and system issuesCharacterizing and optimizing critical components and subsystemsParticipating in the development and validation of operation and software tools  
Helping investigate in\-flight issues and support related analysis  
Maintaining and improving technical documentation, including design and operations manuals  
Managing inventory and procurement activities for hardware  
Requirements:  
A higher education degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in engineering, physics, or a related technical field  
Experience with laboratory instrumentation and electronic diagnostics  
Proficiency in coding in and/or C\+\+ or similar  
A motivated, hands\-on, and collaborative approach to problem\-solving (team player)  
Proficient written English skills required; basic knowledge of German is desirable.  
We offer  
A dynamic and collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading space research institutes  
Involvement in a high\-profile international space mission (ESA's JUICE mission)  
Opportunities to grow technical and scientific expertise in a cutting\-edge laboratory  
Highly interdisciplinary work environment (including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and software engineering)  
Flexible working arrangements and support for professional development  
The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension.  
Your Benefits  
International reputation  
Team\-oriented work  
Central location in the heart of Bern  
Strong research infrastructure and international network  
Working at the University of Bern  
The University of Bern not only offers exciting tasks but also an environment that actively promotes development, diversity, and equal opportunities. Discover what makes us stand out as an employer and how you can grow with us.

Relevant supporting documents

jobs.title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist
jobs.employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Production Chimique
jobs.description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
•    On-site company restaurant

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Männedorf liegt idyllisch am Zürichsee und besticht durch seine verkehrsgünstige Lage mit direkter Bahnanbindung nach Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine perfekte Kombination aus ländlicher Ruhe und urbaner Erreichbarkeit. - Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Männedorf im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern mit Spezialisierung in Demenzbetreuung, besonders für Teilzeitpositionen mit 60 Prozent Pensum. - Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Männedorf

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

jobs.title: Market Manager - Go-to-Market
jobs.description:
Sector Manager - Go-to-Market

Purpose of the job

Define and execute the ADV go-to-market strategy by managing a high-performing global channel partner network to drive growth, increase market share, enhance sales efficiency, and expand market coverage.

Key Objectives / KPIs:

  *  Channel partner Sales growth and Contribution Margin
  *  New generated opportunities and face-2-face customer visits by ADV Account Managers
  *  Revenue by Field Sales headcount
  *  Growth rate by customer classification
  *  Reduction of transactional tasks


Responsibilities:

Channel Partner Network:

  *  Leads the negotiation, review, and amendment of distribution agreements, ensuring ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal legal policies.
  *  Defines the framework for negotiating trade agreements and discount rates led by the regional Sales Channel Manager.
  *  Monitors regular business reviews and opportunity meetings led by the Regional Sales Channel Manager.


Global Channel Partner:

  *  Build and maintain strategic relationships with global channel partners at the senior executive level and organize regular face-to-face strategic meetings and workshops.
  *  Define and drive the strategic partnership roadmap.
  *  Shape and optimize the product portfolio and product branding.


Local Channel Partner and Representatives:

  *  Establish and maintain management-level relationships with local channel partners and representatives.
  *  Define and optimize the product portfolio.
  *  Develops and continuously optimizes performance-based rating systems as the foundation for sales conditions and services provided by VAT.
  *  Monitor channel partner performance and, together with local Channel Partner and ADV Sales Leaders, decide on onboarding new channel partner or phasing out underperforming channel partner.
  *  Supports Regional Sales Channel Managers with standardized analysis tools and templates to monitor channel partner performance and conduct business reviews efficiently.
  *  Support the regional Sales Channel Manager in organizing channel partner meetings.


Digital Sales Channels

  *  Develop the ADV digital customer journey in close collaboration with the data architects to automatize transactional tasks and enhance productivity.
  *  Support channel partners with digital tools and services.
  *  Establish digital customer services in collaboration with other Business Units.


Go-to-Market Strategy:

  *  Develop and execute the annual update of the Go-to-Market Strategy.
  *  Align and reinforce market reach strategy with ADV Sales Leaders and BU Management Team.
  *  Conduct regular reviews with ADV Sales Leaders to monitor progress and implement corrective actions where necessary.


Pricing Strategy:

  *  Support the ADV PM Pricing Team in pricing initiatives and implementation.
  *  Lead sales communication for the annual price adjustment.


Qualifications:

  *  Bachelor's degree in sciences, engineering or economy.
  *  Master in Business Administration.
  *  Fluent business English skills written and spoken.
  *  4+ years working experience in B2B Sales, Account Management or Channel Management.
  *  Vacuum market experience preferred.
  *  Solid experience in managing international projects.
  *  Strong entrepreneurial mindset combined with strategic clarity to identify and capture growth opportunities.
  *  Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives at global scale, spanning processes and systems.
  *  Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  *  High level of ownership: self-driven, decisive, and accountable for outcomes.
  *  International mindset with strong cultural agility and a track record of building trust across regions.

AGRANA JUICE
Passion you can taste.

Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt?

AGRANA ist in der Division Stärke mit fünf Standorten in Zentral- und Osteuropa ein bedeutender Produzent von kundenspezifischen Stärkeprodukten und Bioethanol in Europa. Neben einem ausgezeichneten Arbeitsklima in einem dynamischen Team bieten wir die Möglichkeit, als Teil eines österreichischen Konzerns in herausfordernden Projekten international durchzustarten.

Wir schätzen Menschen, die nach Erfolg streben und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln wollen. Wenn Sie auf der Suche nach Ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt sind und sich gerne neuen beruflichen Herausforderungen stellen, dan... 1 Teamleiter/in (w/m/d) - Produktion Deine neuen Aufgaben:

* Du bist für die diziplinarische und fachliche Führung eines Teams (rund 6 Anlagenfahrer:innen) verantwortlich
* Du bist zuständig für die Kontrolle und Überwachung des zugewiesenen Produktionsprozesses sowie für die Einhaltung der wichtigsten Sicherheits-, brandschutzrechtlichen, Hygiene-, Qualitäts-, Leistungs- und Kostenvorgaben
* Du unterstützt die Schichtleitung bei anfallenden Aufgaben und vertrittst diese im Abwesenheitsfall
* Du optimierst die dir zugewiesene Anlage und führst Maßnahmen im Falle von erkannten Fehlern durch
* Du gestaltest Produktionsarbeitsanweisungen zu Dokumentationszwecken und als "best share practice" für Kolleg:Innen
* Du erstellst Arbeits- und Heißarbeitsfreigaben und Behälterbefahrerlaubnisscheine bei Wartungs- und Instandhaltungstätigkeiten und unterzeichnest unter Einhaltung der anwendbaren Compliance Richtlinien Lieferscheine und Tagesberichte

Deine aussagekräftigen Stärken:

* Du verfügst im besten Fall eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in den Fachbereichen Chemie, Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik und bringst die Motivation mit, dich in diesen Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln
* Du besitzt bereits mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung innerhalb eines Produktionsbetriebes
* Du bist sehr genau, arbeitest gerne in einem Team und hast ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein
* Du bringst gute Computer- sowie sehr gute Deutsch-Kenntnisse mit
* Du zeigst Bereitschaft in einem 3-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten (Jahresplanung vorhanden) und als Teamleitung bist du Mitglied der betrieblichen Feuerwehr. Idealerweise bist du bereits Mitglied einer Freiwilligen Feuerwehr.

Unser Angebot:

* Abwechslungsreiche und interessante Tätigkeit in einem krisensicheren, stabilen, familiären und teamorientierten Arbeitsumfeld
* Eine intensive Einschulung in deinem neuen Aufgabengebiet durch unsere kompetenten Kolleginnen und Kollegen
* Deine Vorteile bei uns: Essenszuschuss, Zukunftsvorsorge, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Betriebsfeiern, Gesundheitsprogramme uvm.
* Der kollektivvertragliche Mindestlohn für diese Position liegt bei monatlich 2.728,78 € brutto. Hinzu kommen eine AGRANA-Schichtzulage von 256,44 €, eine Teamleitungszulage in der Höhe von EUR 186,42 € sowie weitere kollektivvertragliche Zulagen und Zuschläge
* Dein Lohn steigt entsprechend der kollektivvertraglichen Regelungen mit zunehmender Betriebszugehörigkeit und durch kollektivvertragliche Erhöhungen

Deine Ansprechperson:

Alexandra HOCK (HR Managerin)







Als globales Unternehmen sind wir sehr stolz auf unsere vielfältige Belegschaft und legen großen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und Diversität. jobs.description:

jobs.title: Installation Lead
jobs.description:
Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us

Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.

Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!

The role

As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.

As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.

The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:

• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.

• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.

• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.

• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.

• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.

• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.

• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.

• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.

• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?

You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.

You are likely to have:

• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business

• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.

• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.

• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.

• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.

• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.

• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel

We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.

Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer

At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.

This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.

Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

A businesspartner for growth and maintainance, www.briljantin.se

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

 - Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

 - Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

 - Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

 - Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.
