jobs.title: Creative Concept & Content Developer
jobs.description:
At Les Deux, we believe great brands are built at the intersection of culture, community, and product. We’re looking for a Creative Concept & Content Developer who brings strong ideas to the table and helps turn them into inspiring executions.

This role is for someone with a sharp understanding of fashion, culture, and storytelling. You know how to turn a collection into a world people want to be part of — and you understand that the best results are created together. Travel will be part of the role, primarily in connection with our campaigns. However, travel is driven by business needs and is not required for every campaign. We typically run around four main campaigns per year, alongside smaller activations and collaborations.

What you Actually Will be Doing
  • Drive and develop creative concepts for campaigns, collaborations, social media, and brand activations
  • Turn ideas into output, from moodboards and concepts to final content across platforms
  • Art-direct photoshoots, content productions, and brand experiences, while briefing and collaborating with external creatives such as photographers, stylists, and videographers
  • Ensure a 360° rollout both online and offline across social media, campaign materials, POS and physical spaces (stores, pop-ups, activations)
  • Work closely with our Design, Brand Marketing, Social and eCommerce team
  • Help maintain and evolve the visual universe of Les Deux, always with an ambitious mindset where we dare to think the impossible = possible

What You Bring to the Table
  • 3–5 years of experience in a similar creative role within fashion or lifestyle
  • A strong portfolio showcasing campaign development, art direction, and concepts brought to life
  • A solid understanding of both the creative and practical side of content production
  • The ability to balance creative ambition with commercial goals
  • A collaborative mindset with ownership and a strong team spirit

What Success Looks Like
  • Campaigns that feel strong, distinctive, relevant and well executed, not just good on paper.
  • Clear and consistent brand expression across all touchpoints
  • Content and concepts that work across formats and platforms
  • Campaigns and activations that generate attention, engagement and cultural relevance

What We Bring to the Table
  • A workplace built on teamwork, good energy, and mutual support
  • A creative role with real responsibility and influence across campaigns, collaborations, and brand moments
  • A varied workday with close collaboration across Design, Brand, Social, and eCommerce
  • Daily work from our Copenhagen HQ, with flexibility in your workday and a culture built on mutual give-and-take
  • Competitive salary, pension and health care, training facilities, employee discounts, and regular team days and social gatherings
How To Apply

We believe that difference makes us stronger and encourage everyone to apply regardless of age, ethnicity, ability, gender, gender expression, gender identity, nationality, race, religion, or sexual orientation.

If you have been nodding along and are passionate about building one of Europe’s most exciting contemporary fashion brands, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your CV, a short cover letter, and your portfolio explaining why you’d be a great fit. We review applications on an ongoing basis—so don’t wait too long.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral position in freshwater ecology and climate change
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Ecology and Management  

Project Description:

Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of droughts, floods, heatwaves, and storms. Small streams and their surrounding riparian forests are particularly vulnerable to these changes especially in managed forests where streams are already exposed to forestry pressures. Riparian buffers are the primary management tool for mitigating forestry impacts on streams, yet many buffers are poorly designed to maintain key ecological functions, particularly under a changing climate. The project addresses three interlinked questions: 1) how climate-driven extremes affect streams and riparian zones in managed forests; 2) which riparian buffer characteristics are most likely to enhance resistance and resilience to such extremes; and 3) how scientific knowledge on riparian buffers is translated into management guidelines and policy frameworks for climate adaptation.

This is a time-bound knowledge synthesis project that integrates scientific and applied evidence on climate-adapted riparian buffer management, focusing on boreal and hemi-boreal forest ecosystems. The project compiles and evaluates peer-reviewed literature, management guidelines, policy documents and/or available data to produce expected scientific deliverables.

About the position  

The postdoctoral fellow will be part of a collaborative project CLIMRIP (Climate-adapted riparian buffer management: a synthesis of boreal ecosystems and implications for practice) funded by Formas and supervised by principal investigator Associate Prof. Lenka Kuglerová. The project interdisciplinary team includes expertise in hydrology, ecology, freshwater science, microclimate, and social sciences. Support from the SLU library is secured. The postdoctoral fellow will also be part of a larger scientific network of the Krycklan Catchment Study.

The main responsibility of the postdoctoral fellow is to synthesise knowledge related to the three main project questions. Core tasks include:

    Designing and conducting systematic or rapid evidence reviews, meta-analyses, and/or evidence mapping of peer-reviewed literature on climate impacts on boreal streams and riparian zones, and on riparian buffer design for climate resilience.
    Compiling and evaluating management guidelines and policy documents to assess how scientific knowledge on riparian buffers is translated into forestry practice and policy.
    Leading the writing and submission of peer-reviewed publications based on this synthesis work as well as contributing to other scientific output (e.g., reports).
    Collaborating with the project team to integrate findings across disciplines and contribute to practical recommendations for climate-adapted forestry management.
    Presenting results at project meetings, conferences.

Your profile

We seek a talented and motivated postdoctoral researcher who has a strong background in natural sciences including freshwater sciences. The candidate should have a PhD in natural sciences (e.g., ecology, physical geography, forestry), ideally with specialization in freshwater ecology, limnology or similar fields.  We seek a candidate with experience in leading scientific publication process, and the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to produce high-quality publications in English. Experience with reviews, meta-analyses or other knowledge synthesis methods are considered an advantage.

Other merits may include:

    Experience in boreal systems,
    Assessment of climate change impacts,
    Understanding of riparian buffer management,
    Ability to read Swedish,
    Participation in collaborative project teams

We are looking for a candidate with good personal skills, who is well-organized and structured, can work both independently and proactively, and has good communication skills.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us  

The Postdoc. will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 115 people of which 9 are professors. Our mission is to advance the understanding of forest ecosystems and how these should be managed today and in the future. For more information: http://www.slu.se/en/departments/forest-ecology-management/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced PostgreSQL specialist who enjoys working hands-on with complex database environments and large-scale migrations? We are currently looking for a Database Engineer to take a key role in an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration within a large international company operating in the gaming and digital entertainment industry.

Job description:

As a Database Engineer, you will play a central role in the end-to-end migration of database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. The assignment is highly technical and hands-on, while also requiring you to take ownership of the migration journey and act as an important link between the development teams and the database environment.

You will work closely with developers and database specialists to translate application requirements into practical and reliable PostgreSQL solutions. A key part of the role is to review and validate database schemas, configurations and application changes, ensuring that the migration is carried out accurately, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the existing platform.

The applications do not contain PL/SQL code, meaning no PL/SQL conversion is required as part of the assignment.

Key responsibilities:

    Lead and provide hands-on support throughout the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
    Work closely with development teams and database specialists to ensure a smooth migration journey.
    Translate application requirements into practical PostgreSQL database solutions.
    Review and validate database schemas, configurations and application code changes.
    Ensure database performance, compatibility and accuracy throughout the migration.
    Support troubleshooting and technical decision-making related to PostgreSQL.
    Work with Liquibase for database schema versioning and migration.
    Document findings, learnings and best practices to support future database migrations.
    Contribute to a migration approach that minimizes downtime and disruption to business-critical services.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has extensive professional experience working as a PostgreSQL DBA, Database Engineer or PostgreSQL Developer.
    Has deep technical knowledge of PostgreSQL and is comfortable working hands-on with databases.
    Has previous experience from Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration projects.
    Has a good understanding of Oracle databases and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL datatype mappings.
    Has experience reviewing and working with database schemas, SQL, configurations and performance.
    Understands Liquibase and database schema versioning.
    Is comfortable working independently within an established migration framework.
    Has strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoys working closely with software development teams.
    Is proactive, structured and able to take technical ownership of complex migration activities.
    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written, as this is the primary working language.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience working with Java applications connected to PostgreSQL, distributed systems and event-driven architectures such as Kafka and/or Solace. Experience migrating high-traffic services with minimal downtime is also highly valuable. Knowledge of AI-assisted development workflows and tools such as Cursor, Claude or similar agent-based solutions is considered a plus.

Great emphasis will be placed on your ability to combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset. We believe you are someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping development teams move forward. You are comfortable taking initiative, working operationally and contributing both technical expertise and structure throughout the migration.

About the client:

Our client is a large international company operating within the gaming and digital entertainment industry. The organization develops and operates high-traffic digital services used across multiple markets and works continuously to modernize its technology platforms and infrastructure.

Due to the confidential nature of the recruitment process, further information about the company will be shared at a later stage.

About the employment:

This is a 12-month consulting assignment, which means that you will be employed by Friday and work as a consultant for our client.

Other information:

    Scope: Full-time
    Start: As soon as possible, with consideration to any notice period
    Placement: Central Stockholm
    Contact details: Axel Stubbing, axel.stubbing@friday.se

About Friday:

At Friday, we are passionate about helping tech talent find opportunities where they can grow, develop and look forward to going to work. By understanding what motivates you, we match you with companies and assignments that fit both your skills and ambitions.

We value potential and ambition and work actively towards an unbiased recruitment process where everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: Mekaniker - service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger
jobs.description:
SAWO HERLEV

Mekaniker med blik for teknik, kvalitet og løsninger, der holder

Vil du arbejde med mere end standardreparationer – og blive specialist i hydraulik, el og avancerede opbygninger på lastbiler?

Hos SAWO får du faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og mulighed for at udvikle dig i en branche, hvor dit håndværk gør en synlig forskel for kunden hver eneste dag.

Bliv en del af holdet i Herlev

Vi har travlt – og det er der en god grund til. SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Siden 1962 har vi leveret driftssikre, skræddersyede løsninger, og i Herlev har vi brug for endnu en dygtig mekaniker, som vil være med til at holde både udstyr og kundernes hverdag kørende.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent og hjælpsomt værkstedsteam, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og går op i at aflevere et stykke arbejde, vi kan være stolte af.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både planlagte opgaver og faglige udfordringer, der kræver nysgerrighed og en god teknisk forståelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

·     Service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger

·     Fejlfinding på mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske systemer

·     Montering, tilpasning og klargøring af udstyr

·     Kvalitetssikring og dialog med kolleger om den bedste løsning

·     Bidrag til, at kunderne får driftssikkert udstyr og kortest mulig nedetid

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?0

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet eller hverdagen på værkstedet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Oliver Cox på telefon 27 74 76 81.

Job Description

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
    Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
    Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
    Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
    Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
    Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

    6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
    Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
    Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
    Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
    Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
    Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
    Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
    Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
    Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

    CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
    CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
    Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
    Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

jobs.title: GenAI Specialist
jobs.description:
Paiblock, the world’s oldest blockchain company, building enterprise-grade digital currency infrastructure since 2011, is currently looking for a GenAI Specialist, that can help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in crypto payment processing.

We currently repurposing our GenAI-powered assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product.

You will be central to that journey: designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment.

About the role

As our GenAI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer based at our Copenhagen office. You will support technical direction while building production systems alongside the team.

You will work across the full lifecycle of our AI capabilities, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Your work will include, among other things:

  • Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows, including tool and API use, orchestration, context management, grounding, guardrails, and safe fallback or handover paths.

  • Integrating AI systems with internal APIs, data sources, and customer journeys, and building reliable data-ingestion, retrieval, and grounding pipelines that enable relevant and personalized support.

  • Establishing the evaluation, testing, and observability practices needed to operate reliable AI systems, measuring quality, safety, task completion, latency, cost, and failure modes, and using those insights to support controlled self-improvement over time.

  • Setting technical direction and making sound architectural decisions across models, frameworks, data, security, reliability, and platform design.

  • Working closely with the Product Owner, engineers, and business stakeholders to turn customer problems into technically credible, high-value solutions, while raising the team’s technical bar through hands-on collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We offer

Here are some of the benefits of working at Paiblock:

  • An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome

  • Career and development opportunities in a Danish blockchain scaleup

  • Possibility of a hybrid workplace

  • A health-promoting workplace with e.g., fitness programs and various sports activities

  • Attractive insurance benefits and pension

Who are you?

You are a junior engineer or graduate that is deeply curious about the fast-moving AI landscape but grounded in the discipline required to ship reliable products. You enjoy building, testing, measuring, and improving systems in production.

You are a true team player who enjoys lifting others and driving shared technical excellence. You are curious, pragmatic, and unafraid to challenge both technical and business assumptions. Switching between hands-on coding, architectural thinking, and stakeholder dialogue feels natural to you, and you thrive in an international cross-functional, and hybrid working environment.

You're likely bringing:

  • Experience building and deploying agentic systems in production, with hands-on Python engineering skills. This includes practical experience with patterns such as tool use, orchestration, routing, state management, guardrails, agent harness, and human-in-the-loop flows.

  • Experience integrating AI solutions with production APIs, internal data, and business-critical systems, together with strong knowledge of RAG, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and grounding strategies.

  • Experience working with databases and data platforms such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks, including deploying, managing, and integrating them in production environments.

  • Experience designing AI evaluations, test suites, quality metrics, feedback loops, and production monitoring, including tracing, prompt and version tracking, quality monitoring, latency, cost, and incident analysis.

  • Strong cloud and software-engineering practices, Git, security, and reliable API design.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn technical complexity into clear guidance for developers and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till en pojke i Nacka!
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta som personlig assistent och bidra till allas lika rätt till ett bra liv?

I rollen kommer du göra skillnad i människors vardag och tillsammans med oss arbeta efter Humanas vision – Alla har rätt till ett bra liv.

Om tjänsten

Personlig assistans är en insats enligt LSS (Lagen om stöd och Service till vissa funktionshindrade). I din roll som personlig assistent kommer du huvudsakligen att hjälpa kunden med allt som uppstår i vardagen samt med grundläggande behov. Ditt arbete innebär att värna om kundens självbestämmande och integritet, och bidrar till att vardagen fungerar smidigt. Varje assistans är unikt anpassad utifrån kundens liv och därför kan arbetsuppgifter variera beroende på arbetsplatsen.

Vår kund är en glad och kärleksfull kille på snart 4 år som behöver stöd i sin vardag. Vi önskar någon som vill vara med och skapa en lekfull vardag med trygghet. Man ger stöd i lek, aktivitet och träning. Man tränar även på att äta med munnen, samt att få mat via peg. Som assistent hjälper du även till med medicinering. Vi ser helst en person som vill arbeta under en längre period då arbetet bygger mycket på den relation man bygger upp med barnet. Personkemi och engagemang väger tyngst.

Vem är du?

Rollen som personlig assistent ställer höga krav på förmågan att skapa goda relationer. Vi söker därför dig som är lyhörd, engagerad och ansvarstagande. Det är även viktigt att du kan ta egna initiativ och se vad som behöver göras. För att trivas som personlig assistent är det viktigt att det finns bra personkemi mellan dig som assistent och kunden.

För tjänsten krävs det att du har:

    

har goda kunskaper i svenska

    

är rökfri

    

tål pälsdjur

    

är lugn trygg lekfull lyhörd och tålmodig

För tjänsten är det meriterande om du:

    

kompetens inom TAKK och/eller bildstöd

    

erfarenhet av att jobba med barn.

    

erfarenhet av barn med speciella behov

    

erfarenhet av epilepsi

    

erfarenhet av PEG

Stor vikt kommer att läggas kring personlig lämplighet.

Arbetstid, tjänstgöringsgrad och lön

Aktuell anställningsform är ”så länge assistansuppdraget varar” med en tjänstgöringsgrad på cirka 46%. Arbetstiderna är förlagda till dag och kväll.

Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse och övriga ersättningar sker enligt kollektivavtal.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Humana är det viktigt att både du som assistent och kunden känner er trygga i samarbetet. Därför får du som ny assistent en introduktion som är anpassad både till yrkesrollen och till den kund du ska arbeta hos. Du får även tillgång till relevanta utbildningar och möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll – så att du har goda förutsättningar att trivas och känna dig trygg i ditt arbete. Humana har kollektivavtal, försäkringar och friskvårdsförmån.

Vad händer nu?

Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss på Humana är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent måste du vara minst 18 år.

Utifrån lagstiftning krävs att vi som arbetsgivare begär ett registerutdrag från alla anställda som ska arbeta som personlig assistent åt ett barn under 18 år. Därav behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister inför en eventuell anställning. Ytterligare information kommer om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen.

Till dig som arbetar inom rekrytering- och bemanningsföretag samt med annonsförsäljning så undanber vi oss erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vill du veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsansvarig:

Sandra Heras Arvidsson sandra.herasarvidsson@humana.se

jobs.title: Skal du have en plads bag rattet i en af Aarhus’ ambulancer?
jobs.description:
Præhospitalet søger lige nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være en del den regionale ambulancetjeneste i Aarhusområdet. 

Du får hjemmebase på Præhospitalets største base på Bautavej i Aarhus V, hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt, kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har en ledig stilling i DAN-vagtrul til besættelse 1. november 2026, eller efter aftale. Her får du 12-timers vagter i rækkefølgen 6-18, 11-23, 18-06 og 5 fridøgn

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet paramediciner eller ambulancebehandler med autorisation. Du skal være fagligt velfunderet og opdateret inden for dit felt, og du skal have vist, at du tager ansvar for egen faglig udvikling og uddannelse.

Du kommer til at indgå i en organisation, der har fokus på både at løse de daglige opgaver, og hvor opgaverne er under fortsat udvikling. Vi håber, at du vil bidrage til en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret samarbejdskultur – på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Der vil således blive lagt vægt på dine evner til at samarbejde og til at bidrage til et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab i ambulancerne og i Præhospitalet som helhed. 

Du skal have kørekort kategori B og C. 

Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Præhospitalet har ansvaret for det præhospitale område i Region Midtjylland, og vores hovedopgave og vision er ”at sikre rette hjælp i rette tid til alle patienter”. Præhospitalet har som de øvrige hospitaler i regionen både drifts-, behandlings-, uddannelses-, kvalitetssikrings- og forskningsmæssige opgaver. I Præhospitalet møder du kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, og fælles for alle er, at vi stræber efter at gøre det bedste for patienterne.

I Præhospitalet lægger vi vægt på høj faglighed, uddannelse og udvikling. Det håber vi også, at du gør, for kompetencevedligehold og efteruddannelse bliver en lige så fast del af dit arbejde som udrykning og behandling af patienter. Derfor skal du også selv have et ønske om at styrke din egen faglighed og udvikling. Det gør du selvfølgelig ikke alene – for vi hjælper og støtter hinanden, og der er kort vej fra medarbejdere til ledelsen. Vi vil gerne være en attraktiv og rummelig arbejdsplads, og du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og meget gerne bidrage til det fælles arbejdsmiljø. 

Du bliver ansat i Præhospitalets afdeling for ambulancer og akutlægebiler. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsledelse, som består af en ambulancechef og en cheflæge, samt en funktionsledelse bestående af 11 funktionsledere. Funktionslederne varetager personaleledelsen af ambulancepersonalet samt den daglige drift.

Du kommer til at referere til funktionsleder Morten Herlev.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst med FOA.


Yderligere information
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at skrive eller ringe til:
Funktionsleder Morten Herlev
Mail: M.Herlev@rm.dk 
Tlf.: 51152151

Du kan finde flere oplysninger om Præhospitalet her Præhospitalet

Sådan søger du
Du søger nemt stillingen via linket "send ansøgning" nederst på siden. Her bliver du bedt om at udfylde nogle oplysninger om dig selv (navn, adresse mv.) samt vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV.

Ansættelsesproces
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 24. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. august på Olof Palmes Allé i Aarhus N.

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Kan du synge “Hjulene på bussen” uden at miste pusten? Svanen søger vuggestue pædagog
jobs.description:
En attraktiv pædagogstilling i Svanens vuggestue er nu ledig – start 1. november 2026.

Har du en passion for de yngste børn og lyst til at indgå i et nærværende og engageret team? Så kan du være den pædagog, vi leder efter til vores vuggestue.

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af et fællesskab.

Vi leder efter dig, der deler vores værdier, og som gerne vil være en aktiv del af det pædagogiske arbejde og fællesskabet omkring børnene. 

Hos os får du kollegial sparring, fælles ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig i samarbejde med resten af personalegruppen. Hver uge har vi tid sat af til både planlægning og samarbejde. Du får en times forberedelse og 45 minutters stuemøde med dine kollegaer på stuen. Det giver ro til at skabe veltilrettelagte pædagogiske forløb og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, som børnene mærker i hverdagen. Hos os i Svanen ønsker vi os en kultur, hvor man kommer med lige dele faglighed og vilje til samarbejde. I Brøndby Kommune har du ligeledes mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt, da der løbende er tilbud om videreudvikling af pædagogisk personale i form af kurser, uddannelse og faglige oplæg. Vi passer på vores pædagoger og gør os umage med at skabe en rar og spænde arbejdsplads.


Om os
Børnehuset Svanen er et mindre børnehus normeret til 22 vuggestuebørn fordelt på to stuer og 40 børnehavebørn fordelt på to stuer. 

Vi ligger i et område, der byder på mange muligheder for aktiviteter – bl.a. volden, stranden, dyregården, middelalderlandsbyen og kulturhuset. VI har ladcykler som vi ofte bruger til at komme rundt omkring på tur.

Svanen ligger tæt på offentlig transport og har fantastiske fysiske rammer både ude og inde.


Vi søger en pædagog som:

  • Er anerkendende i din tilgang til både børn, forældre og kollegaer

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og som er god til at strukturere en uge med aktiviteter for børnene

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt med en børnegruppe og tage ansvar for eget arbejde

  • Er smilende, energisk og klar på at sætte lege i gang sammen med børnene

  • Har overblik og et godt organiserings-gen så du kan bidrage til at skabe struktur i hverdagen

  • Hvis du er glad for sang, musik og bevægelse er det en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Du kan være nyuddannet eller erfaren – det vigtigste er, at du bygger stærke relationer til børnene og ser dem som de små mennesker, de er

Har du læst med hele vejen og tænker: “Det lyder som mig”? Så håber vi, du har lyst til at tage næste skridt – og blive en del af fællesskabet i Børnehuset Svanen.

Du er velkommen til at give os et kald, hvis du har lyst til en rundvisning. Ring til dagtilbudsleder Katrine på 21 36 63 45.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Ansøgningsfrist:
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 17. september 2026 og vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og d. 21. september fra kl. 12.30 – 16.00.
Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en 37‑timers stilling – men vi ved, at livet kommer i mange former, så vi er åbne for en dialog om arbejdstiden.

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. 

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. 

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

jobs.title: Senior Android Developer
jobs.description:
What will you do?

As a Senior Android Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel Android app. We are in the middle of migrating from Java to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose while continuously shipping product features to a global user base.

You’ll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our Android platform.

Areas of ownership:

    

Drive the migration from Java to a modern Kotlin + Compose stack

    

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

    

Build and modernize Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

    

Contribute to architecture decisions (MVVM/MVI, Coroutines, platform improvements)

    

Collaborate closely with iOS, Web, Product, Design, and QA to ship the right solutions

    

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

    

Maintain and improve the overall health of the Android platform

Requirements:

    

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

    

5+ years of experience building Android applications

    

Strong knowledge of Kotlin (and solid Java understanding)

    

Experience with modern Android architecture (Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, MVVM/MVI)

    

Proven ability to work independently and ship high-quality code

    

You care about the code you leave behind — you ship features without cutting corners

    

You prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over clever complexity

    

Experience migrating legacy Android codebases to modern stacks

    

Experience with mobile CI/CD, testing, or DevOps practices is a plus

    

It's a plus with experience with collaborating across platforms (iOS/Web)

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. jobs.title: Early morning deliverer, Turku region
jobs.description:
Keep your days free - become an early morning deliverer!

Are you looking for a job that leaves your days free for studies, hobbies, family life, or other commitments? Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu regularly offers delivery work in Turku and the surrounding municipalities. The job is an excellent fit for students, early risers, and anyone looking for additional income.

Please note that we do not always have an open delivery route available immediately in every area. We continuously interview candidates and maintain a recruitment pool for different locations. This allows us to quickly contact suitable applicants when a route becomes available near their home.

We invite applicants to interviews based on their place of residence and anticipated recruitment needs in different areas. Bicycle delivery routes are typically offered within approximately 5 kilometres of the applicant's home address.

What is the job like?

As a deliverer, you will work approximately 3-5 hours per night, typically between 1:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m.

The work consists of delivering newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail along a pre-defined route. The standard shift pattern is six consecutive working nights followed by two nights off, providing a predictable work rhythm and helping you plan your free time.

Delivery routes and equipment

- In Turku, deliveries are primarily carried out using a bicycle provided by the employer.
- Outside Turku, routes are completed using either your own car or a company vehicle.
- When a route requires the use of your own car, mileage compensation is paid according to the applicable rate.

Pay and training

- Pay is based on the collective agreement between the Finnish Media Federation and the Industrial Union.
- The average earnings for a new deliverer, including applicable supplements, are approximately €12-13 per hour.
- You will receive paid onboarding, including daytime training and practical guidance on your own route during night shifts.
- In addition, we pay a €900 orientation bonus during the first nine months of employment.

What we offer

- Permanent or fixed-term employment depending on your preferences and available routes
- Comprehensive training and support from the start
- A predictable and stable work schedule
- Independent work with a high degree of responsibility
- An active job that keeps you moving
- Occupational healthcare
- Five weeks of paid annual holiday
- TS Group employee benefits, including a Turun Sanomat subscription and wellbeing benefits
- The opportunity to start work quickly when a suitable route becomes available in your area

What we expect from you

- At least 18 years of age
- Good English or Finnish language skills
- Reasonable physical fitness
- A careful, responsible, and independent working attitude
- Ability and willingness to work at night
- A valid residence permit and the right to work in Finland

Interested?

Apply easily by clicking the "Apply" button below.

Please note that applications submitted by email cannot be processed.

This job posting is available in both English and Finnish. You only need to apply through one of them.

After reviewing applications, we invite selected candidates to interviews and maintain a recruitment pool for future delivery opportunities in different areas.

About Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu

Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu is responsible for the early morning delivery of newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail across 25 municipalities in Southwestern Finland. We employ approximately 500 deliverers and are part of the TS Group.

Our main delivery product is Turun Sanomat, the leading newspaper in the Turku region. As Finland's second-largest newspaper distribution company, we play an important role in ensuring reliable deliveries every day of the year.

Apply today and be ready to start when the right delivery route becomes available near you.

jobs.title: Erfaren maler søges til renoverings- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på Langeland
jobs.description:
Erfaren maler søges til renoverings- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på Langeland

Vi oplever stigende aktivitet og søger derfor en dygtig maler til renoverings- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på Langeland.

Hos os får du en varieret hverdag med stor grad af selvstændighed og ansvar. Du bliver en del af et mindre team med fire fagkollegaer og et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde, hvor flere faggrupper arbejder tæt sammen om at levere gode løsninger til vores kunder.

Er du typen, der tager ansvar for dit arbejde, leverer kvalitet og trives i en hverdag med forskellige opgaver, så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Om jobbet

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært bestå af:

  • Maling af flyttelejligheder

  • Renoveringsopgaver i private og erhvervsejendomme

  • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende bygninger

  • Klargøring, spartling og malebehandling

  • Mindre reparationer og finisharbejde

Vi arbejder primært med renovering og vedligeholdelse – ikke nybyggeri.

Arbejdet udføres både selvstændigt og i samarbejde med kollegaer afhængigt af opgavernes størrelse.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring som maler

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og finish

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har kørekort kategori B

  • Taler dansk eller som minimum engelsk

Det er en fordel, hvis du er bosat på Langeland eller i nærområdet.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast arbejde med varierede opgaver

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Firmabil til rådighed

  • Gode kollegaer

  • Mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar på egne projekter

jobs.title: Job i Malaga - Fundraiser - Din samtale kan gøre en forskel - Start i efteråret!
jobs.description:

Vi har opstart hver måned fra august og resten af året frem. Så du kan blive en del af teamet når det passer med dine planer.

Verden står i en tid, hvor behovet for hjælp er større end nogensinde. Klimaforandringer, konflikter og sociale kriser rammer hårdt, og NGO’erne har brug for stærke stemmer, der kan skabe opmærksomhed og handling.

Som fundraiser bliver du en vigtig del af dette arbejde. Du repræsenterer nogle af Danmarks største NGO’er og hjælper med at sikre støtte til projekter, der gør en reel forskel.

Du bliver NGO’ernes stemme udadtil og kommer til at:

  • Tale med potentielle sponsorer om, hvordan små bidrag skaber stor forandring

  • Skabe meningsfulde samtaler hver dag

Fundraising handler ikke kun om økonomi – det handler om at skabe håb, engagement og bevidsthed.

Du bliver en del af et stort dansk team på vores kontor i Spanien.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har lyst til at lære kommunikation og præsentation

  • Trives i fællesskaber og bidrager til god stemning

jobs.title: Myyjä erikoistavaraliikkeeseen, 37,5h/viikko
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme MYYJÄÄ kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun joulukuun alkuun asti! Tehtävässä saattaa olla mahdollisuus jatkaa määräajankin jälkeen, mutta sitä ei pystytä tässä vaiheessa vielä lupaamaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu aktiivinen myyntityö rempseällä ja iloisella asenteella myymälän puolella sekä muut myymälän avustavat työt, kuten esimerkiksi hyllytys ja myymälän siisteyden ylläpito. Asiakasyrityksemme tuotevalikoimaan kuuluu mm. erilaiset juhlatarvikkeet. Myymälä sijaitsee Turun keskustassa ja työskentely tapahtuu ma-la klo 10-18 välillä ja työaika on 37.5h/viikko. Toivomme aikaisempaa kokemusta kaupan alan, mutta voit olla hankkinut kokemusesi myös esimerkiksi ravintola-alan tehtävistä. Tehtävässä pärjää henkilö, joka pystyy toimimaan ajottaisen kiireenkin keskellä ripeästi sekä vastavuoroisesti hiljaisina aikoina työskentelemään aktiivisesti.

Asiakkaamme tarjoaa sinulle huipputyöporukan lisäksi täydet työtunnit ja työpaikan ainutlaatuisen tuotevalikoiman parissa!

Kiinnostuitko? Paikat täytetään heti sopivian henkilön löydyttyä, joten toimi ripeästi täyttämällä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Hakuaikaa on 31.8.26 asti, mutta haastattelut aloitetaan heti. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden rekrytointipäällikkö Maiju Aarnio, arkisin klo 9-16 p. 050 411 0375.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Responsible
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

jobs.description:
Bliv Kok hos Kjærbøllings Hus i Zoo – Her er Passion for Madlavning Nøglen til Succes!

Er du en passioneret kok, der elsker at arbejde med friske råvarer og skabe kulinariske oplevelser? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Kjærbøllings Hus, beliggende i hjertet af den zoologiske have i København, er ikke kun en restaurant, men et sted hvor kreativitet og kvalitet mødes. Vi er kendt for vores friske råvarer og vores evne til at eksperimentere i køkkenet. Vi laver mad, som vi selv elsker, og vi mener, at glæden ved madlavning smitter af på vores gæster.

Om dig:

- Du er en positiv og engageret person, der bidrager til den gode stemning i restauranten.
- Som en del af vores team, er du støttende og hjælpsom over for dine kollegaer.
- Du har erfaring som kok og en passion for at lære og vokse inden for faget.
- Du er dedikeret, nysgerrig og ansvarsbevidst – både i forhold til dine egne opgaver og hele restaurantens drift.
- Du er velorganiseret, pålidelig og altid klar til at give gæsterne en exceptionel oplevelse.

Vi tilbyder:

- En rolle, hvor du kan udfolde dine kulinariske talenter og sætte dit personlige præg på vores menu.

- Muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

- Et sjovt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor godt samarbejde og positiv energi er i centrum.

- Konkurrencedygtig løn og fordelagtige vilkår, når du spiser på vores restauranter.

Hvorfor vælge Kjærbøllings hus?

Vi vægter et fantastisk arbejdsmiljø højt, hvor der er plads til alle, og hvor stærkt teamwork er nøglen til succes. Hos os skaber vi en atmosfære, hvor alle føler sig motiverede og inspirerede til at yde deres bedste.

Er du klar til at blive en del af vores team og være med til at skabe gastronomiske oplevelser for vores gæster? Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Assistant Professors of Molecular Imaging
jobs.description:
We are looking for three highly motivated and dynamic assistant professors who can lead molecular imaging projects as part of a 3-year position to commence between November 2026 and February 2027.

Our research
Cluster for Molecular Imaging was established in 2004 by Professor Andreas Kjær to pursue translational molecular imaging research. The research is driven by unmet medical needs and includes all steps from molecule identification to evaluation in patients with a strong focus on the transfer of new methods into clinical practice. The research covers several disease areas including oncology, immune-oncology, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammatory diseases. The group has so far translated 5 PET tracers into the clinic.

Cluster for Molecular Imaging has access to all necessary facilities for molecular imaging, including preclinical and clinical imaging facilities, cyclotrons, and radiochemistry as well as laboratories for molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, and a cell laboratory.

The group currently consists of 40 researchers covering a wide range of disciplines, including medicine, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, biology, molecular biology, and physics.

Your job
You will join a multidisciplinary research team working on translational molecular imaging.

You are expected to design, execute and analyse high impact translational research related to molecular imaging. The exact project(s) to be conducted depends on the candidate’s background and experiences.

The assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination duties
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
  • Supporting fundraising activities
Profile
Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

  • You have a PhD in Molecular Imaging or an adjacent field
  • You have an active interest in translational medical research and innovation
  • You have documented pre- and postgraduate teaching experience
  • Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams
  • Strong publication record corresponding to your career stage
  • Excellent English skills written and spoken
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience within areas such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases or related biomedical fields
  • Experience working across academic, clinical, and/or industry settings
  • Interest in innovation, translational science, or implementation of research into practice
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Panum Institute, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week for 1 position, and 18,5 hours for 2 positions.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is in Ot

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 40,000 DKK (November 2025 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information please contact Daniel Murray, daniel.murray@sund.ku.dk.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)
  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do
  4. List of publications
  5. Teaching portfolio (If applicable)
Deadline for applications is 31 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Interviews are expected to be held in week 40-41.



The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Ceph Storage Engineer
jobs.description:
Cleura is one of the leading European providers of IT infrastructure services based on Open Source. Our company provides public, compliant, private and hybrid cloud solutions based on OpenStack and has data centres around the world. We are a fast-growing company & European leader in infrastructure as a service.We love having fun and working hard. We live to get that smile on our customers' faces when we solve a problem or provide something better than expected. That’s, in fact, why we go to work the next day.

Cleura is part of Iver, meaning that we have more than 1300 colleagues to support us in reaching our goals of becoming the primary European IaaS alternative.

We strive for everyone to be engaged and aligned with our fundamental values - We Care, We Inspire, We Challenge & We Communicate.

About the Role :

We are on an exciting journey providing Enterprises and the public sector with regulatory compliant, cloud-based infrastructure services based onCeph. We are a fast-growing company! It means a little chaos is a good thing! We are the European leaders in infrastructure as a service using open source software such as OpenStack.

You will join the team of 2-3 engineers maintaining the storage infrastructure for the global cloud services. This role is about running our current clusters and designing new clusters & enable new features to allow our customers to do even more. We are looking out for a colleague who is a real team player to take on tasks & also like to develop his/her skills, test new features and share ideas to bring us all forward and build an even better service for our customers.

About the team:

    We love Open source! We primarily use Open-source technologies and enjoy contributing back when we can.

    We work in an agile way, when it's relevant.

    We are disciplined when it comes to testing changes.

    We have fun at work. Work hard, play hard.

    We spend time training new people who join the team and adjust how we work together via retrospectives.

Responsibilities:

    Design, architect, monitor, manage and optimize our Ceph storage solution, including tuning and optimizing performance.

    Collaborate with the Cloud Engineering team to ensure proper integration with our OpenStack environment.

    Work with automation tools to efficiently provision and manage our Ceph environment.

    Maintain and upgrade existing clusters.

Requirement/ Must have

    You should have European citizenship.

    You should know Ceph in detail.

    Know about HAproxy and RadosGW.

    Working experience building and using Ansible collections.

    At least four years of experience with similar responsibilities and aproventrack record of implementation is a requirement.

Good to have:

    Experience with distributed storage solutions for Linux like GlusterFS, lustre, zfs, etc.

    Certifications like RHCSA, RHCE, LPI

    Bachelor's degree in the field of information technology or a higher degree.

Personal Qualities:

    Genuinelyinterested in new technologies, software or hardware.

    Well-organized and structured.

What we offer:

    Full-time position with a 6-month probationary period.

    Leave Policy: 6 weeks vacation.

    Remote work: Yes, if it suits you the best.

    Open for Consultants with EU citizenship

We'd like to hear from you! We have a few questions we would like to ask you. You'll be able to apply for this position until 15th of May. We will start reviewing and inviting applications immediately, so make sure you get yours in early. Location: Karlskrona/Stockholm/Remote. Start Date: Immediate/at your earliest convenience.

-Toimialan kokenein ketjuhallinto, jonka kanssa on turvallista kasvaa ja menestyä

-Kokenut ja ammattitaitoinen ohjaus, neuvonta ja tuki arjessasi

jobs.title: Økonomimedarbejder / Bogholder søges til længerevarende vikariat
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i København søger FIRMAVIKAR en erfaren økonomimedarbejder/bogholder til et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat med forventet opstart medio eller ultimo september 2026.

Vi søger en person, der har styr på bogholderiet, arbejder selvstændigt og er vant til at tage ansvar for den daglige økonomifunktion.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer til at arbejde bredt med virksomhedens daglige økonomi og administration. Opgaverne vil blandt andet være:

  • Løbende bogføring og kontering. Langt størstedelen af de månedlige transaktioner er faste og tilbagevendende

  • Debitor- og kreditorstyring

  • Bankafstemninger

  • Fakturering og opfølgning via Moment Flow. Project Leads opretter som udgangspunkt fakturaerne, mens du sikrer, at timer og priser er faktureret korrekt i henhold til de enkelte kontrakter

  • Håndtering og kontrol af bilag

  • Afstemning af konti

  • Moms og klargøring af materiale. Kvartalsmomsen gennemgås sammen med virksomhedens Director inden indberetning

  • Dagligt arbejde i e-conomic

  • 4-øjnes kontrol af løn via Dataløn. Administrationen indtaster som udgangspunkt lønoplysningerne, hvorefter du foretager kontrollen

  • Måneds- og kvartalsafslutning samt rapportering. Der arbejdes ud fra en fast Excel-skabelon, hvor periodiserede tal fra e-conomic overføres og efterfølgende sendes til Director

  • Klargøring af materiale til revisor i forbindelse med årsafslutning pr. 31/12. Da afstemninger foretages løbende, er denne del forholdsvis overskuelig

  • Registrering af betalinger i banken cirka én gang om ugen, typisk 10-15 betalinger. Betalingerne godkendes efterfølgende af Director

  • Back-up for virksomhedens Admin Lead samt løbende overblik over administrative opgaver

  • Øvrige administrative og økonomirelaterede opgaver efter behov

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling og er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt med bogholderi og økonomi.

Det er vigtigt, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med bogholderi og økonomi

  • Har et godt og sikkert kendskab til e-conomic

  • Har erfaring med afstemninger, moms og månedsafslutning

  • Er fortrolig med Excel og kan arbejde med faste rapporteringsskabeloner

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Arbejder struktureret, grundigt og præcist

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med både økonomiopgaver og lettere administrative opgaver

Erfaring med Dataløn og Moment Flow er en fordel.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: København
Opstart: Medio eller ultimo september 2026
Periode: Frem til udgangen af juli 2027
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid

Vi tilbyder

Et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat hos en virksomhed i København, hvor du får en selvstændig og alsidig rolle med ansvar for den daglige økonomifunktion.

Der er gode og faste arbejdsgange på plads, og du vil samtidig have løbende sparring med virksomhedens Director og øvrige administration.

Du bliver ansat gennem FIRMAVIKAR, og vi følger naturligvis op under hele vikariatet.

Interesseret?

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi gennemgår ansøgningerne løbende og indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale.

- A multinational workplace with an informal tone

- Offices located in both Copenhagen and Malmö, with the possibility of working from both locations

Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Malmö. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern European market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial sector. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Finns and Swedes. Our goal is to shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

Cleura is part of Iver , meaning that we have more than 1300 colleagues to support us in reaching our goals of becoming the primary European IaaS alternative.

About the Role

We're hiring an Infrastructure Engineer (OpenStack Neutron Specialist) to be part of the team who own and evolve the OpenStack networking layer that underpins Cleura's cloud services. This role sits within the Infrastructure Engineering team, which is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the infrastructure stack. You'll work closely with compute, storage, platform engineering, support, architecture, serving as a deep subject matter expert across Neutron and associated networking technologies including OVN, Open vSwitch, routing, metadata services, tenant isolation, and network automation.

This is a high-impact role at the heart of the Cleura cloud platform. You'll help ensure the availability, scalability, performance, and security of the networking layer, act as a 3rd/4th line escalation point for complex issues, and represent real-world operational needs in the upstream OpenStack community to help shape the future of Neutron and related projects.

Examples of responsibilities:

    Design scalable, resilient, and secure OpenStack networking platforms with a strong focus on Neutron and OVN/OVS.

    Own the architecture and day-to-day operation of virtual networking services, including L2/L3 networking, DHCP, metadata, floating IPs, NAT, security groups, and tenant segmentation.

    Ensure that OpenStack networking platforms meet security, compliance, and operational standards.

    Support upgrades, lifecycle management, and change execution across OpenStack networking services, with a strong focus on service continuity.

    Troubleshoot complex control plane and data plane issues across OpenStack networking components and the underlying Linux networking stack.

    Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for critical infrastructure services.

    Drive continuous improvements in network automation, provisioning, validation, monitoring, and recovery using infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.

About the team

    We love Open source! We primarily use Open-source technologies and enjoy contributing back when we can.

    We work in an agile way, when it's relevant.

    We are disciplined when it comes to testing changes.

    We have fun at work.

    We spend time to train new people who join the team and adjust how we work together via retrospectives.10% of our working hours are dedicated to Education. You get to sit in the school bench or even hold the teacher stick yourself.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with several years of experience in similar roles, with solid experience working in large-scale OpenStack environments and strong specialist expertise in Neutron, including ML2, OVN, Open vSwitch, routing, DHCP, metadata, provider networks, tenant networks, VLAN/VXLAN/Geneve, and security groups. You are self-driven, confident in your expertise, and have a strong desire to contribute to the success of both the team and our customers.

We also believe that you have the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with infrastructure, support, and architecture teams to solve complex technical problems. Experience contributing to, or working closely with, open-source communities is highly desirable—particularly within OpenStack, Neutron, OVN, Open vSwitch, or related networking projects.

In addition, you have:

    Strong experience in Linux systems administration and troubleshooting.

    A solid understanding of Linux networking concepts such as routing, bridging, namespaces, iptables/nftables, bonding, MTU, and packet flow analysis.

    Extensive experience investigating complex network behavior using tools such as tcpdump, ovs/ovn tooling, logs, and metrics.

    Experience designing and building automation for cloud infrastructure using tools such as Ansible.

    Very strong skills in Python and Bash.

    Experience working with highly available production platforms and change management in mission-critical environments.

    It's a bonus if you have previous experience working for a cloud provider.

What we offer

    Full-time position with 6-months probationary period.

    Leave Policy : 6 weeks vacation.

    Remote work: Work anywhere you want from the EU, and whenever you want, as long as you're working 40 hours a week in 5 working days.

I'm interested. What's next?

We'd like to hear from you! We have a few questions we would like to ask you. You'll be able to apply for this position until 1st of June 2026. We will start reviewing and inviting applications right away, so make sure you get yours in early.

Type of Employment

Full time position.

If you live in Sweden or Germany, you would be directly employed by Cleura or our German subsidiary.

If you live in any country other than Sweden or Germany (but within EU), we will enter into a contractor agreement as applicable to the legal situation in your country.

Salary and compensation will be negotiated during the interview process.

Location

Remote within EU or you are welcome to work in any of our offices in Sweden.

Start Date

Immediate/at your earliest convenience

jobs.title: Digital Content & Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Paiblock is a Fintech company that provides secure access to emerging asset classes to qualified investors, and global crypto payment processing solutions to e-commerce

We are looking for a Content & Creative Lead to join our Copenhagen team. In this role, you will take ownership of our visual content production and bring it to life across our site and channels. You will be responsible for our visual look and feel - setting direction for Paiblock and defining how content shows up everywhere our customers meet us.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong marketing understanding with hands-on content execution. You'll own visual content across our website and channels - the standard, the quality, and making sure we set and keep direction. Using the newest AI tools, you'll produce great content at scale while building automated creative workflows.

The position is full-time and based at Paiblock’s Copenhagen Office in Denmark, where you'll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong commercial focus. You'll also have people responsibility, managing subcontractors who support content production.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Content & Creative Production Manager, you will own content production end-to-end - from setting creative direction to getting content live. You’ll take part in defining the visual bar for Paiblock and make sure everything we launch reflects it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking ownership of overall content production and getting content live across our site and channels - email, socials, creative ads, etc.

  • Using the newest AI tools to execute and produce content at scale

  • Owning the delivery of content packages for new products

  • Setting visual and direction for Paiblock

  • Defining how we use our content on our site

  • Building and setting up automated creative workflows

  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors who support content production

  • Pushing our site and channels to the next level in look and feel

  • And so much more

The Ideal Profile

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-driven and knows all about the newest AI content production tools, with a background in content, creative, or marketing roles, preferably within blockchain or digital lifestyle company.

We imagine that you:

  • Have a strong sense of visual direction, and what good looks like

  • Have a marketing understanding

  • Have strongly adopted AI and use the newest tools to execute and produce content

  • Know how to set up automated creative workflows to scale content production

  • Have experience setting visual direction and look and feel across channels

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

You are someone who:

  • Is motivated by ownership and accountability

  • Is ambitious, takes initiative and turns opportunities into clear, structured actions. And executes them.

  • Is creative and obsessive about quality and detail

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong internal relationships

What We Offer

Our people are at the core of our success, and we work in an environment that values ownership, development, and collaboration - where your contributions make a real impact.

  • A full-time, on-site position at our Copenhagen office in Denmark

  • A role with ownership of our content production and visual direction, with direct impact on how Paiblock shows up everywhere

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social, dynamic, and ambitious workplace culture

  • Hands-on responsibility for setting the creative bar and producing content with the newest AI tools

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues

  • A modern, data- and tech-driven workplace where AI and new tools are actively applied

The Healthcare Assistant will provide high-quality, person-centred care and support to residents in a residential care setting. Observe residents’ physical, emotional and behavioural wellbeing and report any concerns or changes promptly to the nurse or senior staff member. Maintain a clean, safe and comfortable living environment. Follow infection prevention and control procedures, manual handling guidance, safeguarding procedures and health and safety requirements. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Understanding of dignity, confidentiality, safeguarding and person-centred care. Reliable, flexible and willing to work shifts, including weekends where required. Previous experience in residential, nursing, disability or community care is desirable. Relevant healthcare or care qualification is desirable or a willingness to complete required training. Ability to follow care plans, policies, procedures and instructions accurately. Commitment to providing a consistently high standard of care and supporting residents’ quality of life.
