jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. jobs.title: Program Controller
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Program Controller for a global automotive company in Gothenburg. Start is September 1st, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description and main responsibilities

In this role, you will support the development of vehicle programs throughout key milestones. As a Program Controller, you will work closely with the Program Manager and provide support on all financial topics to help steer programs efficiently and effectively.

The role focuses on controlling program investments as well as monitoring the profitability of vehicle programs throughout their full lifecycle. You will collaborate with a wide range of functions, including Program Management, Research & Development, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Planning, Volume Planning, and other key stakeholders.

The position also requires close cooperation with external development partners and program counterparts responsible for creating cost estimates and development work proposals. You will participate in all financial planning processes, including Forecasting, Budgeting, and Business Planning, for your assigned vehicle program. This includes responsibility for both investment tracking and profitability performance.

    

Actively steer the program towards set targets. The program controller is responsible for delivering quality assured data into program milestones and to be an active part in the decision making in the programs

    

Responsible for program cost tracker

    

Responsible for securing and delivering cost and investment data into Program milestones, including explaining what activities that drives variances

    

Responsible for securing accuracy and transparency in the profit model input, Eg by monitoring system status and take actions where needed.

    

Active in decisions related to IPL and/or BPL, by providing timely data, investigations and/or business cases

    

Collaborate with different stakeholders across the company to optimize and staying on top of the profit model inputs

Deliveries

Main task is Actively steer the program towards set targets. The program controller is responsible for delivering quality assured data into program milestones and to be an active part in the decision making in the programs and present financial development over time with a clear message.

Competence requirements

    

7-10 years’ experience in controlling or analyst roles

    

Outstanding analytical capabilities

    

Very strong in excel/data handling

    

Experience in controlling – e.g setting and following up targets

    

Strong project management skills – being the link and center for inputs from numerous internal stakeholders

    

Understanding potential cost and revenue drivers within automotive

Other requirements

    

Self-motivated, driven, and a proactive attitude towards solving issues and suggesting improvements.

    

Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with multiple stakeholders.

    

A solution-oriented mindset to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is September 1st, 6 months contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ruovesi
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.description:
Meille autonasentajaksi?

Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen ammattitaitoista ja ahkeraa autonasentajaa, jolla on hyvä työasenne. Pystyt huoltamaan ja korjaamaan itsenäisesti henkilö- ja pakettiautoja. Sinulta onnistuu vianhaku, diagnosointi sekä haastavammatkin huolto- ja korjaustyöt.

- autoalan koulutusta ja vähintään 1 vuoden työkokemusta alalta
- omatoimisuutta, huolellisuutta sekä tehokasta otetta työntekoon
- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja joustavuutta

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot itsestäsi sekä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Eero Eloranta p. 045 872 3934, sähköposti: eero.eloranta@tampereenautolasipalvelu.fi.

Keitä me olemme?

Olemme paikallinen perheyritys. Meille on tärkeintä työntekijöidemme hyvä viihtyvyys sekä erinomainen asiakaspalvelu laadukkaan työnjäljen lisäksi. Kuulumme valtakunnallisiin Autofit ja First Stop -ketjuihin, jotka takaavat mahdollisuudet esim. lisäkoulutuksiin työntekijöiden oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Työllistämme tällä hetkellä neljä autonasentajaa, kaksi työnjohtajaa ja kaksi tuulilasiasentajaa. Yrityksen virallinen nimi on Tampereen Autolasipalvelu Oy, joka on toiminut jo vuodesta 1993 alkaen. The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

Your Role...
The holder of the position will be a member of the Department of Education and Social Work within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
She/he is expected to:
• Develop and maintain research activities — with national embedding and of (inter)national relevance — explicitly focusing on school management and school development in fundamental education (e.g. pedagogical leadership, organisational management and change management, implementation of educational policies on the ground, quality development and assurance, communication and collaboration, professional competencies and continuing professional development, data and assessment literacy), possibly including the leveraging of digital opportunities (e.g., collaborative technologies), thus identifying and (further) developing best practices that can feed back into both teacher training and the school system;
• Exercise leadership internally and externally both in their field of knowledge and, as a leading educationist, apply their general knowledge and skills as a researcher and scholar;
• Develop and sustain the scale and quality of teaching and learning in the full range of the Faculty's study programmes in Education;
• Undertake tutoring and internship supervision of BScE and BFP students, and engage with national education actors and stakeholders;
• Undertake doctoral and post-doctoral supervision and mentoring, further contributing to the development of doctoral education and training; and
• Undertake leadership roles that ensure that the Faculty further strengthens its position as a leading European multicultural and multilingual site of research and teaching in the field of educational and social sciences.

Teaching areas
The holder will mainly be teaching in the Bachelor en Sciences de l'Education, the new Bachelor en Formation Pédagogique and the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).
The holder will also lead the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).

What we expect from you…
• PhD in educational sciences or a closely related field (a multi/interdisciplinary research profile is particularly welcome);
• A minimum of five years of postdoctoral experience acquired in a university or comparable research centre (teaching and/or school management and development experience in a fundamental education setting is an advantage);
• An outstanding research record in educational and social sciences;
• International research and teaching experience (teaching experience in basic training and/or specialisation programmes for fundamental school teachers is an advantage);
• Proven ability to acquire research funds and conduct cross-national research projects;
• Knowledge of and familiarity with Luxembourg's multilingual educational system and its actors is considered an advantage;
• Willingness to engage in teamwork in teaching and research groups; and
• Ability to work autonomously.

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

With over 1'000 doctoral candidates among 7'500 students as well as 300 professors, the University distinguishes itself with its international and multilingual character, an interdisciplinary approach, and a personalised learning environment.

Your role
The Department of Humanities within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences is seeking a leading academic to join its team as Associate Professor (promotion track) or Full Professor in English Linguistics.
The successful candidate will cooperate with the members of the Department working on research areas such as language variation and change, digital linguistics, digital writing and reading, multilingual practices in education and the workplace, teaching and learning in multilingual contexts, language and literacy development in English as a second language (ESL), and Content and language integrated learning (CLIL).

You will join the Data Management Office (DMO) and play a key role in driving its implementation, governance and continuous development. The DMO has a broader remit covering the quality, integrity and lifecycle management of Client, Payor, Matter and related master data across the firm. Your responsibilities include:

• Driving the design, rollout and continuous improvement of the DMO operating model, including scope, roles, controls, governance routines and interfaces with other departments;
• Defining, maintaining and enforcing firm-wide standards for Client, Payor, Matter and related master data, including validation rules, ownership principles and escalation paths;

• Structuring and leading third-party data enrichment activities, including VAT ID, EUID, business register ID and other identifiers required for reliable operations, compliance, billing and reporting;
• Coordinating with owners of satellite applications to ensure that major master data changes are shared and reflected consistently across systems;
• Leading or contributing to transformation projects impacting master datas, including requirements definition, testing, deployment, adoption and post-implementation follow-up;
• Creating and maintaining DMO procedures, working instructions, control checklists, data dictionaries, accountability matrices, training materials, KPIs and management reporting;
• Coaching DMO Officer(s), reviewing complex cases and promoting a culture of data accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience, in finance operations, data governance, process management, business transformation or a comparable field;

• You are able to define standards, controls, KPIs, procedures and practical governance routines;

• You have a good understanding of ERP, CRM, compliance and finance data flows; knowledge of Elite is a strong asset;

With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

    • Design and development of deep learning algorithms for EO imagery and related datasets
    • Development of related documentation (Algorithm baseline, functional analysis)
    • Definition of data requirement for processing chain.
    • Writing engineering documentation and technical reports in English.
    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

Must Have Requirements

Profile

• 5-8 years of experience in AI and data science algorithm development (preferable for satellite Remote Sensing or imagery/video data).

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

• Experience with Deep Learning and/or simple Machine Learning techniques, attention- based architecture, foundation model (adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating and, where relevant, pre-training foundation models for Earth Observation data -Vision and Large Language models in particular);
• Proficiency in python with solid object-oriented programming practices and experience building modular, scalable pipelines;
• Strong hands-on proficiency in PyTorch; (familiarity with TensorFlow or other ML frameworks is an advantage);
• Hands-on experience with popular specialized libraries (rasterio, xarray, geopandas, terratorch);
• Familiarity with Linux environments;
• Knowledge of Rest API for querying EO data repositories (e.g. STAC), with expertise in creating, validating, and maintaining robust training datasets;
• Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning or deep learning models in production environments;
• Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized AI applications;
• Experience designing, developing and maintaining model inference APIs or services;
• Good understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, versioning and retraining;
• Hands-on experience with GPU-based training and/or inference, HPC/Slurm;
• Practical experience with at least one production computing environment, such as cloud platforms, Kubernetes-based infrastructures or HPC systems.

Behavior skills (Soft Skills)

• Analytical, critical and proactive mind;
• Very good task prioritization and organization: ability to allocate tasks and track progress;
• Very good technical mentoring (supporting and upskilling junior profiles);
• Very good communication skills: acting as the link between the technical team and management/other departments;
• Fluency in English (spoken and written) is essential;
• High degree of autonomy and decision-making;
• Versatility: comfortable operating at a hands-on capacity while coordinating the team's work.

Being considered as a plus:

• Knowledge of other programming or coding languages such as IDL, C, C++;
• Experience with physical modelling (e.g. hydraulic, hydrology, crop, …);
• MLOps Skills (Docker, microservices);
• Experience with HPC, distributed training, or GPU-accelerated computation;
• Knowledge of Satellite data processing;
• PostDoc in Remote Sensing or ML.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
JOENSUU

Kerroshoidon vuoropäällikkö Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan Joensuuhun

Haemme Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan kerroshoidon vuoropäällikköä. Vuoropäällikkönä tehtäviisi kuuluu vieraidemme erinomaisestapalvelukokemuksesta huolehtiminen sekä siivoustyön laadun varmistaminen yhdessätiimisikanssa. Olet mukanapäivittäisessä kerroshoidon tekemisessä omalla esimerkilläsi johtaen. Kerroshoitajana tärkein tehtäväsi on varmistaa asiakkaillemme erinomainen hotellielämys huolehtimalla siisteydestä. Lisäksi osaamisesi puhtausalan ammattilaisena on tärkeä osa tulevaa vuoropäällikkyyttä. Puhtausalan osaamisesi ja perehdyttämistaitosi suomen kielellä ovat arkipäivää kerros- ja ravintolasiivouksessa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen ja työtunteja tarjoamme sinulle 75–90 h /3 vk. Tunteja on mahdollista kasvattaa ristiintyöskentelemällä esim. ravintolassa.

Loistaaksesi näissä hommissa, tulisi sinulta löytyäpositiivinen asenne työhön sekä aitoa kiinnostusta asiakaspalvelutyöhön. Aikaisempi kokemus ja/tai alan koulutus katsotaan hakijalle eduksi. Olethan oma-aloitteinen ja yhteistyökykyinen, sinulla on hyvät tiimityötaidot ja joustavuutta muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Luonteeltasi olet ahkera ja siedät hyvin stressaaviakin tilanteita.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. Saat käyttöösiPKO:n ja S-ryhmän erinomaiset henkilöstöedutErinomaiset edut –PKO. Meillä työnantaja on vakuuttanut jokaisen työntekijän myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella ja liikkumistasi kannustamme Epassilla.Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiinpitkin matkaa.

Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Architecte Responsable d'Agence capable d'allier expertise technique, pilotage de projets et esprit entrepreneurial.
Votre mission
Rattaché à la Direction Générale du groupe, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et opérationnelle de l'agence de Barcelone.
Vous intervenez sur les projets de l'esquisse jusqu'à la réalisation, tout en participant à la structuration de l'activité locale, à la coordination des équipes et au développement futur du pôle Barcelone.
Vos principales responsabilités
Expertise technique et suivi des projets
- Assurer la mise au point des projets de l'esquisse au DCE : plans, coupes, façades, carnets de détails ;
- Établir et superviser les pièces écrites et graphiques relatives aux dossiers administratifs : PC, PA, permis de démolir ;
- Produire et suivre les pièces graphiques relatives aux marchés de travaux ;
- Gérer, coordonner et synthétiser les éléments des différents intervenants : maîtrise d'ouvrage, services d'urbanisme, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle, partenaires techniques ;
- Analyser la faisabilité technique des projets et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Développement, coordination et management
- Participer à la structuration de l'agence de Barcelone et de ses méthodes de travail ;
- Contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration et au pilotage progressif des futures équipes ;
- Développer un réseau de partenaires et représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur ;
- Participer au développement de nouvelles activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives innovantes.
Profil recherché
- Formation Architecte ou équivalent ;
- Expérience confirmée en cabinet d'architecture, bureau d'études, ingénierie, construction ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation bâtiment : ERP, RT 2012, RE 2020, Code du Travail, ICPE, PMR, CDAC/CNAC ;
- Maîtrise des outils professionnels : Autocad, Revit, Photoshop, SketchUp, BIM ou équivalent ;
- Expérience en coordination de projets, pilotage d'activité ou management appréciée ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et capacité à structurer une activité locale ;
- Rigueur, réactivité, sens du relationnel et goût pour le travail en équipe ;
- Goût pour l'innovation constructive et les environnements internationaux.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compétence technique, nous recherchons une personne capable de s'investir durablement dans un projet ambitieux, avec l'envie de participer activement à la construction et au développement d'une organisation appelée à jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration :
- CDI ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des partenaires du groupe ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Kokenut huskyopas Pure Lapland / Wild Husky Rovaniemi Oylle
jobs.description:
**Kokenut huskyopas – tule mukaan Lapin talvikauteen!**

Onko sinulla kokemusta huskyvaljakon ajamisesta ja asiakkaiden opastamisesta? Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**

Työtehtäväsi

Huskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen

- moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta

- asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin

- huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät

- varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito

- asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.

**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

jobs.title: Job i Malaga? Book et kald med os i dag og hør alt om vores danske kontor og fællesskab i Malaga centrum.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at arbejde i solen? ☀️ Vi søger nye kollegaer til vores danske kontor i Malaga. Book et kald med os i dag, så tager vi en uforpligtende snak om hvad vi kan tilbyde.

Vil du være en del af et dynamisk og socialt team, hvor du kan opbygge stærke relationer og gøre en positiv forskel? Så har vi plads til dig på vores danske kontor i Malaga!

Vi søger engagerede fundraisere til at kontakte potentielle donorer og præsentere vores NGO-projekter. Dit arbejde vil bidrage til at skabe øget bevidsthed om, hvor lidt der skal til for at gøre en stor forskel. Du vil samarbejde tæt med teamet for at sikre støtte til vores projekter.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast løn efter kvalifikationer og en kontrakt med ordnede forhold.

  • Faste arbejdstider med fri om aftenen og i weekenderne.

  • Betalt frokost på arbejdet.

  • Løbende træning i salgskommunikation og personlig udvikling.

  • Et socialt og støttende arbejdsmiljø med et stærkt fællesskab.

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for salg og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har en passion for velgørenhed og ønsker at gøre en forskel.

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og opbygge relationer.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er også en teamplayer.

  • Du er åben for at lære og udvikle nye færdigheder.

  • Du kan arbejde fuldtid i en periode på minimum 4-6 måneder.

Hvem er vi?

Vores danske kontor i Málaga har eksisteret siden 2012, og vi støtter forskellige NGO-projekter. Kontoret er kendt for sin inkluderende kultur og stærke sammenhold. Her bliver du en del af et team med 50 kollegaer på tværs af aldersgrupper, og du møder alle ansatte i løbet af dagen.

Arbejdsplads og miljø

  • Vi har et inspirerende og socialt arbejdsmiljø med en flad ledelsesstruktur.

  • Fokus på fællesskab, engagement og respekt.

  • Teammøder fyldt med energi og humor.

  • En kultur, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og inklusion.

  • Vi tror på, at alle kan gøre en forskel!

Vil du være en del af vores team?

Uanset om du allerede bor i Málaga eller overvejer at flytte hertil, så er du velkommen hos os! Kom forbi vores kontor, drik en kop kaffe hvis du er i nærhenden og oplev vores unikke fællesskab. Du er også velkommen til abre at sende en ansøgning og så tager vi en snak med dig om muligheden.

Du kan se kontoret og kulturen på dette link

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?
At tage til udlandet og arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kan være en berigende oplevelse, både personligt og professionelt.

Her er nogle fordele, det kan have for din karriere fremadrettet:

  • Når du arbejder i udlandet, udvider du dine horisonter og får indsigt i forskellige kulturer og arbejdsmetoder.

  • Det gør dig mere åben og fleksibel, hvilket er værdifulde kvaliteter i et globalt arbejdsmarked.

  • Arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kræver stærke kommunikationsevner og evnen til at overbevise og engagere potentielle donorer. Disse kompetencer er eftertragtede i mange erhverv, da de viser, at du kan formidle budskaber effektivt og skabe positive relationer.

  • Derudover skaber du et internationalt netværk af kontakter og forbindelser, som kan være nyttige for din fremtidige karriere.

  • At have erfaring fra udlandet viser også, at du er initiativrig og villig til at tage chancer, hvilket kan imponere fremtidige arbejdsgivere.

  • Fundraising-arbejde kan føre til muligheder inden for marketing, salg, og nonprofit-organisationer, hvor dine kommunikative færdigheder og evnen til at opbygge relationer er afgørende.

  • Endelig viser det, at du kan tilpasse dig forskellige arbejdsmiljøer og håndtere udfordringer med positivt engagement. Dette gør dig til en attraktiv kandidat på arbejdsmarkedet, da virksomheder ofte søger medarbejdere, der kan navigere i en global kontekst og bidrage til deres vækst og udvikling.

Vil du med på holdet? Så grib chancen og ansøg nu! Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Huoltoneuvoja
jobs.description:
Haemme kasvavaan joukkoomme **Huoltoneuvojaa**, jolla on jo kokemusta korjaamotoiminnasta ja joka viihtyy monipuolisessa asiakaspalvelu- ja työnjohtoroolissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat autohuollon asiakaspalvelu, korjaamon työnjohto, ajanvaraukset, varaosatilaukset sekä päivittäinen yhteistyö asiakkaiden, asentajien ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaan huoltokokemus on sujuva alusta loppuun.

**Meistä**

Autosta Oy on Espoon Muuralassa toimiva autohuolto- ja rengasalan yritys, jonka lisäksi harjoitamme kuljetusliiketoimintaa. Olemme osa arvostettuja **Mekonomen Autohuolto- ja Vianor-ketjuja**, mikä tarjoaa asiakkaillemme laadukkaat palvelut ja työntekijöillemme vahvan tuen päivittäiseen tekemiseen.

Liiketoimintamme kasvaa jatkuvasti, ja etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ammattilaista mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuttamme.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- Kokemusta autohuollon huoltoneuvojan tehtävistä tai korjaamotyöskentelystä

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti kiireisessäkin työympäristössä

- Sujuvaa tietokoneen ja erilaisten ohjelmistojen käyttöä

- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sekä asiakaspalveluun riittävää englannin kielen osaamista

- Positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Kiinnostusta autoalaa ja sen jatkuvaa kehittymistä kohtaan

- Autoalan koulutus, tekninen osaaminen, sekä kokemus esimerkiksi AutoFutur korjaamojärjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

- Vakituisen työpaikan kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaasi ja yrityksen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

- Joustavan työnantajan, joka arvostaa työntekijöidensä panosta

- Hyvät henkilöstöedut

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi autoalan ammattilaisena


**Arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Täysipäiväinen työ on mahdollista toteuttaa myös neljän arkipäivän työviikkona hieman pidemmillä työpäivillä. Lisäksi työskentelemme ainoastaan arkipäivisin, joten viikonloput jäävät vapaaksi.**

Meillä työtä tehdään hyvässä hengessä ja yhdessä joukkueena. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, reipasta asennetta ja halua palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

**Hae mukaan tiimiimme**

Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi, jotta hakemus tulee huomioiduksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Santtu. Arjen kiireiden vuoksi pyydämme mahdolliset puhelintiedustelut arkipäivisin klo 17 jälkeen.

Hakemukset Santtu Niemiselle osoitteeseen etunimi.sukinimi@autosta.fi ja puhelintiedustelut numerosta nolla neljä nolla 555 29 23.

**Autosta Oy**_Pidetään autot liikkeellä, yhdessä._

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotikuntoutus ja turva-auttamistiimi, Kirkkonummi
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia vakituisiin työsuhteisiin Kirkkonummen kotikuntoutustiimiin. Tehtävään kuuluu kotikuntoutuksen lisäksi vuoroja turva-auttamistehtävässä. Työskentelyalue voi tarpeen mukaan muuttua tai laajentua.

Kotikuntoutus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun muassa Läntisen sairaala-alueen, Seniori-infon ja alueellisen kotihoidon kanssa, vastateten sairaalasta kotiutuvien ikääntyneiden kotiutuksista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksesta kotona, turva-auttamisen käynneistä, sekä palvelutarpeen arviosta yhdessä Seniori-infon kanssa.

Lähihoitajan työ kotikuntoutuksessa on asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa itsenäistä, asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Tavoitteena on mahdollistaa asiakkaan toimivaa arkea ja tukea kotona asumista.

Lähihoitajan työhön kuuluvissa turva-auttamisvuoroissa keskeisiä vastuualueita ovat turva-auttamisasiakkaiden hälytystehtävien vastaanotto sähköisen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja vaihtuvien asiakkaiden kotiin jalkautuminen itsenäisesti. Asiakkaan luona tehdään tilannearvio ja arvio tämän kotikuntoisuudesta. Käynnillä annetaan asiakkaan tarvitsema välitön ensiapu ja muu tuki, arvioidaan lisäavun tarve ja tarvittaessa järjestetään se asiakkaalle. Käynneillä on mahdolisuus muiden ammattiryhmien konsutointiin.

Työhön kuuluu myös turvapuhelinten ja muiden turvalaitteiden asennus asiakkaille ja turvalaitteiden toiminnan tarkistaminen.

Kirjaaminen on iso osa niin kotikuntoutuksen kuin turva-auttamipalvelun työtä. Käynneillä tehdään kirjaukset Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmään sekä raportoidaan tarvittaessa eteenpäin toisille ammattilaisille. Yhteistyötä tehdään eri viranomaistahojen, kuten kotihoidon ja sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystyksen kanssa.

Työssä pääsee takuuvarmasti hyödyntämään monipuolisesti lähihoitajan osaamista!

Työssä korostuvat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, vastuullisuus sekä tiimityöskentelytaidot. Työyksikkö ja esihenkilö ovat tukena ja varmistavat, että työ sujuu. Työ on moniammatillista. Tiimiin kuuluu lähihoitajien lisäksi sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, sekä lääkäri.

Työ on jaksotyötä, johon kuuluu aamu- ja iltavuoroja sekä viikonlopputyötä.

Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana, joten haethan pian - odotamme hakemustasi!

Työpaikan osoite: Jokiniityntie 2, 02400 Kirkkonummi
Työaika: 114h 45min/ 3 viikossa
Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Lähihoitajan nimikkeellä toimivalta edellytetään oikeutta käyttää tehtävään soveltuvaa nimikesuojattua ammattinimikettä. Eduksi katsotaan osaamisalana perustason ensihoito, sairaanhoito ja huolenpito tai pelastajatutkinnon perustason ensihoidon suuntautumisvaihtoehto.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- ruotsin kielen taito on eduksi
- ajokortti on pakollinen
- lääkehoitolupa ei ole pakollinen, mutta se tulee suorittaa koeajan puitteissa

Toivomme, että
- ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita
- tunnet sote-alan päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön
- olet yhteistyötaitoinen: kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti ja osaat arvioida asiakkaan tilanteen ja hoidon tarpeen nopeasti
- pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- sinulla on valmius itsenäiseen kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden kotona

Arvostamme
- ensiapuosaamista
- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoitotyöstä ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat
- uusien järjestelmien ketterä käyttöönottokyky
- aiempaa kokemusta työssä tarvittavista järjestelmistä (Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

jobs.title: Butcher / meat cutter
jobs.description:
Tenon Luonnontuote is looking for a skilled professional butcher for reindeer meat processing for autumn 2026.

The work starts at the beginning of October, when the reindeer season begins, and continues until the end of November.

Main duties: deboning and cutting reindeer meat, cutting and sawing meat, packing meat products, assisting in the production of meat products, other tasks related to meat processing.

We are looking for an experienced and reliable butcher with professional skills in meat cutting. Experience with reindeer meat is considered an advantage.

Language requirements: Finnish or English.

Free accommodation. We provide free accommodation next to the workplace for the entire duration of the employment.

Work in the beautiful Arctic North. Tenon Luonnontuote is located in Nuorgam, the northernmost village in Finland and the European Union, right next to the Norwegian border.

Working in Nuorgam offers a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful Arctic nature, spectacular landscapes, outdoor activities and, as autumn progresses, the possibility of seeing the Northern Lights.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available.

Rødbyhavn Denmark

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Engagement Manager | Carve-out | Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for an Engagement Manager with significant experience from operational related M&A projects, specifically within carve-outs. The role is part of our Nordic practice and can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, working closely with colleagues and clients across the region.





Your key responsibilities



As an Engagement Manager in EY-Parthenon’s dedicated carve-out practice, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients navigate complex carve-out transactions and separation programs. Working across the full deal lifecycle, from pre-sign strategy and diligence through post-sign execution, you will support both buy-side and sell-side engagements.



In this role, you will help organizations make critical decisions that shape business performance, operational readiness, and long-term value creation. You will work closely with leading corporates and investors on high-profile, complex transactions, while also contributing to the continued growth and evolution of our market-leading carve-out practice, capabilities, and team. Some of the key responsibilities include;



    Leading buy- and sell-side carve-out engagements from pursuit and scoping through delivery and client management
    Driving carve-out analyses, standalone operating model design, cost assessments, separation planning, and TSA scoping
    Establishing and leading Separation Management Offices for Day 1 and IPO readiness programs
    Supporting the development and expansion of our carve-out offering
    Mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture





Skills and attributes for success



    Proven experience leading carve-out and separation programs across the deal lifecycle, gained within strategy consulting, transaction advisory, corporate development, M&A, or a related environment.
    Strong understanding of operational M&A and value creation, with the ability to translate complex transaction challenges into actionable solutions.
    Master’s degree in business and economics, Engineering or equivalent
    Great communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and preferably Swedish or another Nordic language
    Ability to structure and solve complex problems and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders





Ideally, you’ll also



    Have experience from post-signing related activities, including sign-to-close planning, cutover planning, and PMO / Deal team support throughout the transaction life cycle
    Experience from other technical separation related topics, including vendor and/or customer contract separation, legal entity structuring and optimization
    Have experience leading value creation related projects, both identification and quantification as well as execution
    Being a team player with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels in EY and with clients, both in the Nordics and internationally





What We Look For



    An agile, business and growth-oriented mindset. We’re looking for innovative individuals who can work in an agile way and adapt to a changing business environment
    Curiosity and a purpose-driven approach. We seek people who see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to build a better working world
    Inclusivity. We value individuals who embrace diverse perspectives and work inclusively to build safety and trust





What we offer you



You will join a collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment where you will receive significant responsibility early on and you could develop rapidly as a professional. By joining our team, we offer:

    Opportunity to work on complex and high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in high-stakes transactions environments
    High-performing, inclusive, collaborative, fun, and entrepreneurial team culture
    Modern offices in central locations in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, and flexible ways of working as part of our Nordic Hybrid Model.

Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



The application deadline is August 30th, 2026. We will review your application before the summer vacations and start the interviewing process during August. For inquiries about the position, contact Viktor Köpman at viktor.kopman@parthenon.ey.com, and for recruitment process questions, reach out to Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com.



Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Valkeakoskelle. Käynnit 2 kertaa viikossa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Requirements Engineer
jobs.description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._


_Why Basemark? Basemark offers you the chance to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a collaborative, international environment. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important.
